CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.GetFeeStatementTransactions
(
    @UserId      INT,
    @AdmissionId INT,
    @FromDate    DATE,
    @ToDate      DATE,
    @IncludeOpeningBalance BIT = 0
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.RequirePermission @UserId, N'Reports.View';

    ;WITH ChargeRows AS
    (
        SELECT
            bc.BillingChargeId AS TransactionId,
            bc.AdmissionId,
            bc.EnrollmentId,
            bc.C
hargeDate AS TransactionDate,
            ft.FeeTypeName,
            bc.BillingMonth,
            CAST(N'CHARGE' AS nvarchar(20)) AS TransactionType,
            CAST(bc.NetAmount AS decimal(18,2)) AS DebitAmount,
            CAST(
                ISNULL(
                    (
                        SELECT SUM(fpa.Amount)
                        FROM dbo.FeePaymentAllocations AS fpa
                        INNER JOIN dbo.FeePayments AS fp
                            ON fp.FeePaymentId = fpa.FeePaymentId
                        WHERE fpa.BillingChargeId = bc.BillingChargeId
                          AND fpa.AdmissionId = bc.AdmissionId
                          AND (@ToDate IS NULL OR fp.PaymentDate <= @ToDate)
                          AND fp.Status = N'Completed'
                    ),
                    0
                ) AS decimal(18,2)) AS PaidAmount,
            CAST(0 AS decimal(18,2)) AS CreditAmount,
            CAST(
                CASE
                    WHEN bc.NetAmount -
                         ISNULL(
                             (
                                 SELECT SUM(fpa.Amount)
                                 FROM dbo.FeePaymentAllocations AS fpa
                                 INNER JOIN dbo.FeePayments AS fp
                                     ON fp.FeePaymentId = fpa.FeePaymentId
                                 WHERE fpa.BillingChargeId = bc.BillingChargeId
                                   AND fpa.AdmissionId = bc.AdmissionId
                                   AND (@ToDate IS NULL OR fp.PaymentDate <= @ToDate)
                                   AND fp.Status = N'Completed'
                             ),
                             0
                         ) < 0
                    THEN 0
                    ELSE bc.NetAmount -
                         ISNULL(
                             (
                                 SELECT SUM(fpa.
Amount)
                                 FROM dbo.FeePaymentAllocations AS fpa
                                 INNER JOIN dbo.FeePayments AS fp
                                     ON fp.FeePaymentId = fpa.FeePaymentId
                                 WHERE fpa.BillingChargeId = bc.BillingChargeId
                                   AND fpa.AdmissionId = bc.AdmissionId
                                   AND (@ToDate IS NULL OR fp.PaymentDate <= @ToDate)
                                   AND fp.Status = N'Completed'
                             ),
                             0
                         )
                END AS decimal(18,2)) AS Balance,
            CAST(NULL AS int) AS FeePaymentId,
            CAST(NULL AS nvarchar(80)) AS ReceiptNumber,
            CAST(NULL AS nvarchar(60)) AS PaymentMethod,
            bc.Remarks
        FROM dbo.BillingCharges AS bc
        INNER JOIN dbo.FeeTypes AS ft
            ON ft.FeeTypeId = bc.FeeTypeId
        WHERE bc.AdmissionId = @AdmissionId
          AND (@FromDate IS NULL OR bc.ChargeDate >= @FromDate)
          AND (@ToDate IS NULL OR bc.ChargeDate <= @ToDate)
          AND bc.Status <> N'Cancelled'
    ),
    PaymentRows AS
    (
        SELECT
            CAST(fp.FeePaymentId AS bigint) AS TransactionId,
            fp.AdmissionId,
            fp.EnrollmentId,
            fp.PaymentDate AS TransactionDate,
            CAST(N'Payment' AS nvarchar(200)) AS FeeTypeName,
            CAST(NULL AS date) AS BillingMonth,
            CAST(N'PAYMENT' AS nvarchar(20)) AS TransactionType,
            CAST(0 AS decimal(18,2)) AS DebitAmount,
            CAST(
                ISNULL(
                    (
                        SELECT SUM(fpa.Amount)
                        FROM dbo.FeePaymentAllocations AS fpa
                        WHERE fpa.FeePaymentId = fp.FeePaymentId
                          AND fpa.AdmissionId = fp.Admissi
onId
                    ),
                    0
                ) AS decimal(18,2)) AS PaidAmount,
            CAST(
                ISNULL(
                    (
                        SELECT SUM(fpa.Amount)
                        FROM dbo.FeePaymentAllocations AS fpa
                        WHERE fpa.FeePaymentId = fp.FeePaymentId
                          AND fpa.AdmissionId = fp.AdmissionId
                    ),
                    0
                ) AS decimal(18,2)) AS CreditAmount,
            CAST(0 AS decimal(18,2)) AS Balance,
            fp.FeePaymentId,
            fp.ReceiptNumber,
            fp.PaymentMethod,
            fp.Remarks
        FROM dbo.FeePayments AS fp
        WHERE fp.AdmissionId = @AdmissionId
          AND (@FromDate IS NULL OR fp.PaymentDate >= @FromDate)
          AND (@ToDate IS NULL OR fp.PaymentDate <= @ToDate)
          AND fp.Status = N'Completed'
    )
    SELECT
        TransactionType, TransactionId, AdmissionId, EnrollmentId, TransactionDate,
        FeeTypeName, BillingMonth, DebitAmount, PaidAmount, CreditAmount, Balance,
        FeePaymentId, ReceiptNumber, PaymentMethod, Remarks
    FROM ChargeRows

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        TransactionType, TransactionId, AdmissionId, EnrollmentId, TransactionDate,
        FeeTypeName, BillingMonth, DebitAmount, PaidAmount, CreditAmount, Balance,
        FeePaymentId, ReceiptNumber, PaymentMethod, Remarks
    FROM PaymentRows
    WHERE PaidAmount <> 0

    ORDER BY TransactionDate, TransactionType, TransactionId;
    IF @IncludeOpeningBalance = 1
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @OpeningTo DATE = DATEADD(DAY, -1, @FromDate);
    DECLARE @TotalCharges DECIMAL(18,2) = ISNULL((
        SELECT SUM(bc.NetAmount)
        FROM dbo.BillingCharges bc
        WHERE bc.AdmissionId = @AdmissionId
          AND bc.Status <> N'Cancelled'
          AND bc.ChargeDate <= @OpeningTo

    ), 0);

    DECLARE @TotalPayments DECIMAL(18,2) = ISNULL((
        SELECT SUM(fpa.Amount)
        FROM dbo.FeePaymentAllocations fpa
        INNER JOIN dbo.FeePayments fp ON fp.FeePaymentId = fpa.FeePaymentId
        WHERE fpa.AdmissionId = @AdmissionId
          AND fp.PaymentDate <= @OpeningTo
          AND fp.Status = N'Completed'
    ), 0);

    SELECT (@TotalCharges - @TotalPayments) AS OpeningBalance;

    END;
END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.GetStudentAnnualFeeReceipts
@UserId INT, @AdmissionId INT, @AcademicYearId INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXECUTE dbo.RequirePermission @UserId, N'Fees.Statement.View';
    IF @AdmissionId <= 0
        THROW 59801, 'A valid student is required.', 1;
    IF @AcademicYearId <= 0
        THROW 59802, 'A valid academic year is required.', 1;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                   FROM   dbo.Students
                   WHERE  AdmissionId = @AdmissionId)
        THROW 59803, 'The selected student was not found.', 1;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                   FROM   dbo.AcademicYears
                   WHERE  AcademicYearId = @AcademicYearId)
        THROW 59804, 'The selected academic year was not found.', 1;
    WITH     OriginalPayments
    AS       (SELECT FP.FeePaymentId,
                     FP.AdmissionId,
                     FP.EnrollmentId,
                     FP.PaymentDate,
                     FP.ReceiptNumber,
                     FP.TotalAmount AS IssuedAmount,
                     FP.Status AS PaymentStatus,
                     FP.PaymentMethod,
                     FP.ReferenceNumber,
                     ISNULL(R.ReversedAmount, 0) AS ReversedAmount
              FROM   dbo.FeePayments AS FP
                     INNER JOIN
                     dbo.Enrollments AS E\
n                     ON E.EnrollmentId = FP.EnrollmentId OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(-RV.TotalAmount) AS ReversedAmount
                                                                      FROM   dbo.FeePayments AS RV
                                                                      WHERE  RV.RelatedFeePaymentId = FP.FeePaymentId
                                                                             AND RV.TotalAmount < 0 AND RV.Status=N'Completed') AS R
              WHERE  FP.AdmissionId = @AdmissionId
                     AND E.AcademicYearId = @AcademicYearId
                     AND FP.RelatedFeePaymentId IS NULL AND FP.Status IN (N'Completed',N'Reversed'))
    SELECT   OP.FeePaymentId,
             OP.ReceiptNumber,
             OP.PaymentDate,
             OP.PaymentMethod,
             OP.ReferenceNumber,
             OP.IssuedAmount,
             CASE WHEN OP.PaymentStatus=N'Reversed' THEN OP.IssuedAmount ELSE OP.ReversedAmount END AS ReversedAmount,
             CASE WHEN OP.PaymentStatus=N'Reversed' THEN CAST(0 AS decimal(12,2)) ELSE OP.IssuedAmount - OP.ReversedAmount END AS LiveAmount,
             CASE WHEN OP.PaymentStatus=N'Reversed' THEN N'Fully reversed' WHEN OP.ReversedAmount <= 0 THEN N'Issued' WHEN OP.IssuedAmount - OP.ReversedAmount <= 0 THEN N'Fully reversed' ELSE N'Partially reversed' END AS ReceiptStatus,
             S.AdmissionId,
             S.StudentName,
             S.FatherName,
             S.RegistrationNumber,
             AY.YearName AS AcademicYearName,
             CAMP.CampusName,
             C.ClassName,
             SEC.SectionName,
             SP.SchoolName,
             FT.FeeTypeName,
             BC.BillingMonth,
             FPA.Amount AS LineAmount,
             FT.DisplayOrder AS LineOrder
    FROM     OriginalPayments AS OP
             INNER JOIN
             dbo.Students AS S
             ON S.AdmissionId = OP.AdmissionId
             INNER
 JOIN
             dbo.Enrollments AS E
             ON E.EnrollmentId = OP.EnrollmentId
             INNER JOIN
             dbo.AcademicYears AS AY
             ON AY.AcademicYearId = E.AcademicYearId
             LEFT OUTER JOIN
             dbo.CampusClassSections AS CCS
             ON CCS.ClassSectionId = E.ClassSectionId
             LEFT OUTER JOIN
             dbo.Campuses AS CAMP
             ON CAMP.CampusId = CCS.CampusId
             LEFT OUTER JOIN
             dbo.Classes AS C
             ON C.ClassId = CCS.ClassId
             LEFT OUTER JOIN
             dbo.Sections AS SEC
             ON SEC.SectionId = CCS.SectionId CROSS JOIN (SELECT   TOP (1) SchoolName
                                                          FROM     dbo.SchoolProfile
                                                          ORDER BY SchoolProfileId) AS SP
             INNER JOIN
             dbo.FeePaymentAllocations AS FPA
             ON FPA.FeePaymentId = OP.FeePaymentId
             INNER JOIN
             dbo.BillingCharges AS BC
             ON BC.BillingChargeId = FPA.BillingChargeId
             INNER JOIN
             dbo.FeeTypes AS FT
             ON FT.FeeTypeId = BC.FeeTypeId
    WHERE    FPA.Amount <> 0
    ORDER BY OP.PaymentDate, OP.FeePaymentId, CASE WHEN BC.BillingMonth IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, BC.BillingMonth, FT.DisplayOrder, FT.FeeTypeName;
END

   The RDLC report definitions (LeaveCertificate.rdlc /
   CollegeLeaveCertificate.rdlc) already had an unused "CopyType" field
   wired into their dataset -- this fills it in. The report prints nothing
   extra for the Original, 
and "DUPLICATE COPY" for either duplicate.

   @LeaveCertificateIssueId is optional: when supplied (the UI now passes
   the specific issuance row the user selected/printed), CopyType comes
   from that issue. When omitted/0 (any other/older caller), it falls back
   to the most recently issued copy, same as before this change.
============================================================================ */

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.GetLeaveCertificatePrintData
    @UserId INT,
    @LeaveRecordId INT,
    @LeaveCertificateIssueId INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXEC dbo.RequirePermission
        @UserId,

    IF @LeaveRecordId <= 0
        THROW 57310,
            'A valid leave certificate is required.',
            1;

    DECLARE @CopyType NVARCHAR(20);

    IF @LeaveCertificateIssueId > 0
        SELECT @CopyType = IssueType
        FROM dbo.LeaveCertificateIssues
        WHERE LeaveCertificateIssueId = @LeaveCertificateIssueId
          AND LeaveRecordId = @LeaveRecordId;

    IF @CopyType IS NULL
        SELECT TOP (1)
            @CopyType = IssueType
        FROM dbo.LeaveCertificateIssues
        WHERE LeaveRecordId = @LeaveRecordId

    SELECT

        LC.StudentName,

        LC.DateOfAdmission,

        LC.LeaveDate,
        LC.AcademicRecord,
        LC.AttendanceRecord,
        LC.Remarks,
        LC.CreatedAt AS DateOfIssue,
        ISNULL(@CopyType, N'Original') AS CopyType

    FROM dbo.LeaveCertificates AS LC

END;

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.GetRegularStudentCertificatePrintData
    @UserId INT,

AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXEC dbo.RequirePermission
        @UserId,
        N'Certificates.Print';

    IF @RegularStudentCertificateId <= 0
        THROW 58520, 'A valid regular student certificate is required.', 1;

    SELECT
        RSC.RegularStudentCertificateId,
        RSC.AdmissionId,

        RSC.CertificateNumber AS CertificateNumber,

        RSC.StudentName,
        RSC.FatherName,
        RSC.DateOfBirth,
        RSC.ClassName,
        RSC.CertificateDate,
        RSC.CreatedAt AS DateOfIssue,

        LTRIM(RTRIM(CONCAT(
            SP.SchoolName,
            N' ',
            C.CampusName,
            N' ',
            COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.City)), N''), SP.City)
        ))) AS InstitutionLine

    FROM dbo.RegularStudentCertificates AS RSC

             S.AdmissionDate,
             S.RegistrationNumber,
             S.StudentName,

CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.ConfirmPromotedAdmission
@UserId INT, @EnrollmentId INT, @ReturnDate DATE, @UsesTransport BIT, @FeeChoices dbo.ReturnFee
ChoiceType READONLY
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    EXECUTE dbo.RequirePermission @UserId, N'Students.Administer';
    IF @ReturnDate IS NULL
       OR @ReturnDate > CONVERT (DATE, SYSDATETIME())
        THROW 53010, 'Enter a valid return date that is not in the future.', 1;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1
               FROM   @FeeChoices
               WHERE  Amount < 0
                      OR DiscountAmount < 0
                      OR DiscountAmount > Amount)
        THROW 53011, 'Each fee amount and discount must be valid.', 1;
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;
    DECLARE @AdmissionId AS INT, @AcademicYearId AS INT, @ClassSectionId AS INT, @EnrollmentDate AS DATE, @BillingReady AS BIT, @YearEnd AS DATE, @CampusId AS INT, @ClassId AS INT;
    SELECT @AdmissionId = E.AdmissionId,
           @AcademicYearId = E.AcademicYearId,
           @ClassSectionId = E.ClassSectionId,
           @EnrollmentDate = E.EnrollmentDate,
           @BillingReady = E.BillingReady
    FROM   dbo.Enrollments AS E WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
    WHERE  E.EnrollmentId = @EnrollmentId
           AND E.Status = N'Active';
    IF @AdmissionId IS NULL
       OR @BillingReady <> 0
        THROW 53012, 'This promoted enrollment is not awaiting return confirmation.', 1;
    SELECT @YearEnd = AY.EndDate
    FROM   dbo.AcademicYears AS AY
    WHERE  AY.AcademicYearId = @AcademicYearId;
    IF @ReturnDate < @EnrollmentDate
       OR @ReturnDate > @YearEnd
        THROW 53013, 'Return date must be within the promoted academic year.', 1;
    SELECT @CampusId = CCS.CampusId,
           @ClassId = CCS.ClassId
    FROM   dbo.CampusClassSections AS CCS
    WHERE  CCS.ClassSectionId = @ClassSectionId;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1
               FROM   dbo.StudentFeeAssignments AS SFA
                      INNER JOIN
                      dbo.FeeTypes AS FT
                      ON FT.FeeTypeId = SFA.FeeTypeId
 
              WHERE  SFA.EnrollmentId = @EnrollmentId
                      AND SFA.CancelledAt IS NULL
                      AND FT.IsMandatory = 1
                      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                      FROM   @FeeChoices AS C
                                      WHERE  C.FeeTypeId = SFA.FeeTypeId))
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
                  FROM   @FeeChoices AS C
                  WHERE  NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                     FROM   dbo.StudentFeeAssignments AS SFA
                                            INNER JOIN
                                            dbo.FeeTypes AS FT
                                            ON FT.FeeTypeId = SFA.FeeTypeId
                                     WHERE  SFA.EnrollmentId = @EnrollmentId
                                            AND SFA.CancelledAt IS NULL
                                            AND FT.IsMandatory = 1
                                            AND SFA.FeeTypeId = C.FeeTypeId))
        THROW 53014, 'Review every mandatory class fee before confirming return.', 1;
    UPDATE SFA
    SET    Amount         = C.Amount,
           DiscountAmount = C.DiscountAmount,
           UpdatedAt      = SYSDATETIME()
    FROM   dbo.StudentFeeAssignments AS SFA
           INNER JOIN
           @FeeChoices AS C
           ON C.FeeTypeId = SFA.FeeTypeId
    WHERE  SFA.EnrollmentId = @EnrollmentId
           AND SFA.CancelledAt IS NULL;
    IF @UsesTransport = 1
        BEGIN
            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                           FROM   dbo.FeeConfigurations AS FC
                                  INNER JOIN
                                  dbo.FeeTypes AS FT
                                  ON FT.FeeTypeId = FC.FeeTypeId
                           WHERE  FC.CampusId = @CampusId
                                  AND FC.ClassId = @ClassId
                                  AND FC.Fr
equency = N'Monthly'
                                  AND FT.IsTransportLinked = 1)
                THROW 53015, 'Transport cannot be selected without a monthly class fee.', 1;
            INSERT dbo.StudentFeeAssignments (EnrollmentId, AdmissionId, FeeTypeId, Amount, DiscountAmount, Frequency, Remarks)
            SELECT @EnrollmentId,
                   @AdmissionId,
                   FC.FeeTypeId,
                   FC.Amount,
                   0,
                   FC.Frequency,
                   N'Chosen at return admission'
            FROM   dbo.FeeConfigurations AS FC
                   INNER JOIN
                   dbo.FeeTypes AS FT
                   ON FT.FeeTypeId = FC.FeeTypeId
            WHERE  FC.CampusId = @CampusId
                   AND FC.ClassId = @ClassId
                   AND FT.IsTransportLinked = 1
                   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                   FROM   dbo.StudentFeeAssignments AS SFA
                                   WHERE  SFA.EnrollmentId = @EnrollmentId
                                          AND SFA.FeeTypeId = FC.FeeTypeId
                                          AND SFA.EffectiveTo IS NULL);
        END
    DECLARE @CutoffDay AS INT = (SELECT TOP (1) FeeProrationCutoffDay
                                 FROM   dbo.SchoolProfile);
    DECLARE @BillingStartDate AS DATE = CASE WHEN @CutoffDay BETWEEN 1 AND 28
                                                  AND DAY(@ReturnDate) >= @CutoffDay THEN DATEADD(month, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ReturnDate), MONTH(@ReturnDate), 1)) ELSE @ReturnDate END;
    UPDATE dbo.Enrollments
    SET    BillingReady      = 1,
           ReturnConfirmedAt = CONVERT (DATETIME2 (0), @ReturnDate),
           BillingStartDate  = @BillingStartDate,
           UsesTransport     = @UsesTransport
    WHERE  EnrollmentId = @EnrollmentId;
    EXECUTE dbo.PostEnrollmentOpeningCharges @EnrollmentId = @EnrollmentId;

    INSERT  dbo.EnrollmentHistory (EnrollmentId, AdmissionId, ActionType, ActionDate, OldClassSectionId, NewClassSectionId, OldStatus, NewStatus, Remarks, UserId)
    VALUES                       (@EnrollmentId, @AdmissionId, N'ReturnConfirmed', @ReturnDate, @ClassSectionId, @ClassSectionId, N'Active', N'Active', N'Admission confirmed after promotion', @UserId);
    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    SELECT @EnrollmentId AS EnrollmentId,
           @AdmissionId AS AdmissionId,
           @BillingStartDate AS BillingStartDate;
END

BEGIN

       OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                      FROM   @Selection)

    IF @ChargeDate IS NULL
       OR @ChargeDate > CONVERT (DATE, SYSDATETIME())

    IF @Amount IS NULL
       OR @Amount <= 0
       OR @DiscountAmount < 0
       OR @DiscountAmount > @Amount

    IF NULLIF (LTRIM(RTRIM(@Reason)), N'') IS NULL

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                   FROM   dbo.FeeTypes

    BEGIN TRANSACTION;
    DECLARE @LockResult AS INT;

    IF @LockResult < 0
        THROW 53019, 'This fee posting is already being processed. Try again.', 1;
    DECLARE @BadReason AS NVARCHAR (400);

WHEN E.BillingReady <> 1 THEN N'their enrolment is not ready for billing yet.' Date,

CREATE   FUNCTION dbo.fn_ExpectedRecurringChargeMonths
(@EnrollmentId INT, @AsOfDate DATE)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
    WITH   EnrollmentWindow
    AS     (SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(ISNULL(E.BillingStartDate, E.EnrollmentDate)), MONTH(ISNULL(E.BillingStartDate, E.EnrollmentDate)), 1) AS StartMonth,
                   DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(CASE WHEN E.LeavingDate IS NULL
                                                OR E.LeavingDate > @AsOfDate THEN @AsOfDate ELSE E.LeavingDate END), MONTH(CASE WHEN E.LeavingDate IS NULL
                                                          
                                                                           OR E.LeavingDate > @AsOfDate THEN @AsOfDate ELSE E.LeavingDate END), 1) AS EndMonth
            FROM   dbo.Enrollments AS E
            WHERE  E.EnrollmentId = @EnrollmentId
                   AND E.Status IN (N'Active', N'Promoted', N'Completed', N'Left')
                   AND E.BillingReady = 1),
           Months
    AS     (SELECT EW.StartMonth AS BillingMonth,
                   EW.StartMonth AS AnchorMonth,
                   EW.EndMonth
            FROM   EnrollmentWindow AS EW
            WHERE  EW.StartMonth <= EW.EndMonth
            UNION ALL
            SELECT DATEADD(MONTH, 1, M.BillingMonth),
                   M.AnchorMonth,
                   M.EndMonth
            FROM   Months AS M
            WHERE  M.BillingMonth < M.EndMonth)
    SELECT SFA.StudentFeeAssignmentId,
           SFA.FeeTypeId,
           M.BillingMonth
    FROM   dbo.StudentFeeAssignments AS SFA CROSS JOIN Months AS M
    WHERE  SFA.EnrollmentId = @EnrollmentId
           AND SFA.CancelledAt IS NULL
           AND SFA.Frequency = N'Monthly'
           AND (SFA.EffectiveFrom IS NULL
                OR M.BillingMonth >= SFA.EffectiveFrom)
           AND (SFA.EffectiveTo IS NULL
                OR M.BillingMonth <= SFA.EffectiveTo)

CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.GetBillingCycleStatus
@UserId INT, @AcademicYearId INT, @CampusId INT=0, @AsOfDate DATE=NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXECUTE dbo.RequirePermission @UserId, N'Fees.Reports.View';
    SET @AsOfDate = COALESCE (@AsOfDate, CONVERT (DATE, SYSDATETIME()));
    DECLARE @Month AS DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@AsOfDate), MONTH(@AsOfDate), 1);
    WITH   InScope
    AS     (SELECT E.EnrollmentId,
                   CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                     FROM   dbo.BillingCharges AS BC
                                     WHERE  BC.EnrollmentId = E.EnrollmentId
                                            AND BC.BillingMonth = @Month
       
                                     AND BC.ChargeKind = N'Monthly'
                                            AND BC.Status <> N'Cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsBilled
            FROM   dbo.Enrollments AS E
                   INNER JOIN
                   dbo.CampusClassSections AS CCS
                   ON CCS.ClassSectionId = E.ClassSectionId
            WHERE  (@AcademicYearId = 0 OR E.AcademicYearId = @AcademicYearId)
                   AND E.Status = N'Active'
                   AND E.BillingReady = 1
                   AND @Month >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(ISNULL(E.BillingStartDate, E.EnrollmentDate)), MONTH(ISNULL(E.BillingStartDate, E.EnrollmentDate)), 1)
                   AND (@CampusId = 0
                        OR CCS.CampusId = @CampusId)
                   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                               FROM   dbo.StudentFeeAssignments AS SFA
                               WHERE  SFA.EnrollmentId = E.EnrollmentId
                                      AND SFA.CancelledAt IS NULL
                                      AND SFA.Frequency = N'Monthly'
                                      AND (SFA.EffectiveFrom IS NULL
                                           OR @Month >= SFA.EffectiveFrom)
                                      AND (SFA.EffectiveTo IS NULL
                                           OR @Month <= SFA.EffectiveTo)))
    SELECT @AcademicYearId AS AcademicYearId,
           @CampusId AS CampusId,
           @Month AS BillingMonth,
           COUNT(*) AS TotalActiveEnrollments,
           COALESCE (SUM(IsBilled), 0) AS BilledThisMonth,
           COUNT(*) - COALESCE (SUM(IsBilled), 0) AS RemainingToBill
    FROM   InScope;
END

    WITH   Eligible

FA.FeeTypeId

                                                                  ORDER BY BC.BillingChargeId) AS BC
            WHERE  E.AcademicYearId = @AcademicYearId AND E.Status = N'Active'
                   AND E.BillingReady = 1
                   AND SFA.CancelledAt IS NULL
                   AND SFA.Frequency = N'Monthly'
                   AND @Month >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(ISNULL(E.BillingStartDate, E.EnrollmentDate)), MONTH(ISNULL(E.BillingStartDate, E.EnrollmentDate)), 1)

                   AND NOT (E.Status = N'Promoted'
                            AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                        FROM   dbo.Enrollments AS NX
                                        WHERE  NX.AdmissionId = E.AdmissionId
                                               AND NX.EnrollmentId > E.Enrollmen
tId

/* =====================================================================
   7. dbo.GetDateOfBirthCertificatePrintData

      CertificateNumber is derived the same way Leave Certificate /
      Character Certificate derive theirs - a formatted string built
      from the identity column, not a separately stored/tracked
      sequence. It is printed on the report as "S. No." to match the
      school's existing paper certificate.

      SchoolName is pulled LIVE from dbo.SchoolProfile at print time
      (never snapshotted onto the certificate row itself), same
      reasoning already documented in SchoolProfile_Schema.sql: the
      school's own identity does not change per-certificate, and any
      later correction to the school's profile should be reflected on
      certificates printed afterwards.

      DateOfBirthInFigures/DateOfBirthInWords are pre-formatted here in
      SQL (same approach already used for CertificateNumber) so the
      report itself stays a simple field-binding layout with no date
      arithmetic of its own:
        DateOfBirthInFigures -> "01-04-1998"
        DateOfBirthInWords   -> "01st, 
April, 1998"
   ===================================================================== */

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.GetDateOfBirthCertificatePrintData
    @UserId INT,
    @CertificateRecordId INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXEC dbo.RequirePermission
        @UserId,
        N'Certificates.Print';

    IF @CertificateRecordId <= 0
        THROW 58800, 'A valid date of birth certificate is required.', 1;

    SELECT
        DBC.CertificateRecordId,
        DBC.AdmissionId,

        DBC.CertificateNumber AS CertificateNumber,

        DBC.StudentName,
        DBC.FatherName,
        DBC.Gender,
        DBC.DateOfBirth,

        CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DBC.DateOfBirth, 105) AS DateOfBirthInFigures,

        CONCAT(
            RIGHT(N'0' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(2), DAY(DBC.DateOfBirth)), 2),
            CASE
                WHEN DAY(DBC.DateOfBirth) IN (1, 21, 31) THEN N'st'
                WHEN DAY(DBC.DateOfBirth) IN (2, 22)     THEN N'nd'
                WHEN DAY(DBC.DateOfBirth) IN (3, 23)     THEN N'rd'

            DATENAME(MONTH, DBC.DateOfBirth),

        ) AS DateOfBirthInWords,

        DBC.CertificateDate,
        DBC.CreatedAt AS DateOfIssue,

        SP.SchoolName

    FROM dbo.DateOfBirthCertificates AS DBC

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SchoolProfile AS SP
        ON 1 = 1

    WHERE DBC.CertificateRecordId = @CertificateRecordId;

CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.GetStudentRegister
@UserId INT, @CampusId INT=0, @AcademicYearId INT=0, @ClassId INT=0, @SectionId INT=0, @Gender NVARCHAR (20)=NULL, @StudentStatus NVARCHAR (30)=NULL, @EnrollmentStatus NVARCHAR (30)=NULL, @Search NVARCHAR (200)=NULL, @AdmittedFrom DATE=NULL, @AdmittedTo DATE=NULL, @IncludeFormerStudents BIT=0, @IncludeBalance BIT=0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXECUTE dbo.RequirePermission @UserId, N'Reports.View';
    DECLARE @CanViewDetails AS BIT = 0;
    BEGIN TRY
        EXECUTE dbo.RequirePermission @UserId, N'Students.View';
        SET @CanViewDetails = 1;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        SET @CanViewDetails = 0;
    END CATCH
    DECLARE @Today AS DATE = CAST (GETDATE() AS DATE);
    DECLARE @SearchText AS NVARCHAR (200) = NULLIF (LTRIM(RTRIM(@Search)), N'');
    DECLARE @StatusFilter AS NVARCHAR (30) = NULLIF (LTRIM(RTRIM(@StudentStatus)), N'');
    DECLARE @EnrolFilter AS NVARCHAR (30) = NULLIF (LTRIM(RTRIM(@EnrollmentStatus)), N'');
    DECLARE @GenderFilter AS NVARCHAR (20) = NULLIF (LTRIM(RTRIM(@Gender)), N'');
    SELECT   S.AdmissionId,
             S.AdmissionNumber,
             S.RegistrationNumber,
             S.StudentName,
             S.FatherName,
             S.Gender,
             S.ContactNumber,
             S.AdmissionDate,
             AC.CampusName AS AdmissionCampusName,
             S.Status AS StudentStatus,
             YEAR(S.AdmissionDate) AS AdmissionYear,
             S.WithdrawalDate,
             AdmC.ClassName AS AdmissionClassName,
             AdmSEC.SectionName AS AdmissionSectionName,
             LeftC.ClassName AS LeavingClassName,
             LeftSEC.SectionName AS LeavingSectionName,
             CASE WHEN @CanViewDetails = 1 THEN S.DateOfBirth END AS DateOfBirth,
             CASE WHEN @CanViewDetails = 1
                       AND S.DateOfBirth IS NOT NULL THEN DA
TEDIFF(YEAR, S.DateOfBirth, @Today) - CASE WHEN DATEADD(YEAR, DATEDIFF(YEAR, S.DateOfBirth, @Today), S.DateOfBirth) > @Today THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END AS Age,
             CASE WHEN @CanViewDetails = 1 THEN S.BFormNumber END AS BFormNumber,
             CASE WHEN @CanViewDetails = 1 THEN S.BloodGroup END AS BloodGroup,
             CASE WHEN @CanViewDetails = 1 THEN S.Religion END AS Religion,
             CASE WHEN @CanViewDetails = 1 THEN S.CasteTribe END AS CasteTribe,
             CASE WHEN @CanViewDetails = 1 THEN S.Disability END AS Disability,
             CASE WHEN @CanViewDetails = 1 THEN S.PlaceOfBirth END AS PlaceOfBirth,
             CASE WHEN @CanViewDetails = 1 THEN S.AlternateContactNumber END AS AlternateContactNumber,
             CASE WHEN @CanViewDetails = 1 THEN S.Address END AS Address,
             CASE WHEN @CanViewDetails = 1 THEN S.GuardianName END AS GuardianName,
             CASE WHEN @CanViewDetails = 1 THEN S.GuardianRelation END AS GuardianRelation,
             CASE WHEN @CanViewDetails = 1 THEN S.FatherOccupation END AS FatherOccupation,
             CASE WHEN @CanViewDetails = 1 THEN S.PreviousSchool END AS PreviousSchool,
             CASE WHEN @CanViewDetails = 1 THEN S.BiseEnrolmentNumber END AS BiseEnrolmentNumber,
             E.EnrollmentId,
             E.AcademicYearId,
             AY.YearName,
             COALESCE (CCS.CampusId, S.AdmissionCampusId) AS CampusId,
             COALESCE (CC.CampusName, AC.CampusName) AS CampusName,
             C.ClassId,
             C.ClassName,
             C.DisplayOrder AS ClassOrder,
             SEC.SectionId,
             SEC.SectionName,
             AP.ProgramType,
             E.EnrollmentDate,
             E.Status AS EnrollmentStatus,
             E.LeavingDate,
             CASE WHEN E.EnrollmentId IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN E.UsesTransport = 1 THEN N'Yes' ELSE N'No' END AS Transport,
             E.BillingStartDate,
            
 CASE WHEN @CanViewDetails = 1 THEN FAM.FamilyCode END AS FamilyRef,
             CASE WHEN @CanViewDetails = 1 THEN FAM.FamilyMemberCount END AS FamilyMemberCount,
             CASE WHEN @IncludeBalance = 1 THEN ISNULL((SELECT SUM(dbo.GetFeeChargeBalance(BC.BillingChargeId))
                                                        FROM   dbo.BillingCharges AS BC
                                                        WHERE  BC.AdmissionId = S.AdmissionId
                                                               AND BC.Status <> N'Cancelled'), 0) END AS OutstandingBalance
    FROM     dbo.Students AS S
             INNER JOIN
             dbo.Campuses AS AC
             ON AC.CampusId = S.AdmissionCampusId OUTER APPLY (SELECT   TOP (1) E1.*
                                                               FROM     dbo.Enrollments AS E1
                                                               WHERE    E1.AdmissionId = S.AdmissionId
                                                                        AND (@AcademicYearId = 0
                                                                             OR E1.AcademicYearId = @AcademicYearId)
                                                                        AND (@EnrolFilter IS NULL
                                                                             OR E1.Status = @EnrolFilter)
                                                               ORDER BY CASE WHEN E1.Status = N'Active' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, E1.EnrollmentDate DESC, E1.EnrollmentId DESC) AS E
             LEFT OUTER JOIN
             dbo.AcademicYears AS AY
             ON AY.AcademicYearId = E.AcademicYearId
             LEFT OUTER JOIN
             dbo.CampusClassSections AS CCS
             ON CCS.ClassSectionId = E.ClassSectionId
             LEFT OUTER JOIN
             dbo.Campuses AS CC
             ON CC.CampusId = CCS.CampusId
             LEFT OUTER JOIN
             dbo.Classes AS C

             ON C.ClassId = CCS.ClassId
             LEFT OUTER JOIN
             dbo.Sections AS SEC
             ON SEC.SectionId = CCS.SectionId
             LEFT OUTER JOIN
             dbo.AcademicPrograms AS AP
             ON AP.AcademicProgramId = C.AcademicProgramId OUTER APPLY (SELECT   TOP (1) E2.ClassSectionId
                                                                        FROM     dbo.Enrollments AS E2
                                                                        WHERE    E2.AdmissionId = S.AdmissionId
                                                                        ORDER BY E2.EnrollmentDate ASC, E2.EnrollmentId ASC) AS AdmE
             LEFT OUTER JOIN
             dbo.CampusClassSections AS AdmCCS
             ON AdmCCS.ClassSectionId = AdmE.ClassSectionId
             LEFT OUTER JOIN
             dbo.Classes AS AdmC
             ON AdmC.ClassId = AdmCCS.ClassId
             LEFT OUTER JOIN
             dbo.Sections AS AdmSEC
             ON AdmSEC.SectionId = AdmCCS.SectionId OUTER APPLY (SELECT   TOP (1) E3.ClassSectionId
                                                                 FROM     dbo.Enrollments AS E3
                                                                 WHERE    E3.AdmissionId = S.AdmissionId
                                                                          AND E3.LeavingDate IS NOT NULL
                                                                 ORDER BY E3.LeavingDate DESC, E3.EnrollmentId DESC) AS LeftE
             LEFT OUTER JOIN
             dbo.CampusClassSections AS LeftCCS
             ON LeftCCS.ClassSectionId = LeftE.ClassSectionId
             LEFT OUTER JOIN
             dbo.Classes AS LeftC
             ON LeftC.ClassId = LeftCCS.ClassId
             LEFT OUTER JOIN
             dbo.Sections AS LeftSEC
             ON LeftSEC.SectionId = LeftCCS.SectionId OUTER APPLY (SELECT   TOP (1) F.FamilyCode,
      
                                                                              (SELECT COUNT(*)
                                                                                     FROM   dbo.FamilyMembers AS FM2
                                                                                     WHERE  FM2.FamilyId = FM.FamilyId) AS FamilyMemberCount
                                                                   FROM     dbo.FamilyMembers AS FM
                                                                            INNER JOIN
                                                                            dbo.Families AS F
                                                                            ON F.FamilyId = FM.FamilyId
                                                                   WHERE    FM.AdmissionId = S.AdmissionId
                                                                   ORDER BY FM.IsPrimaryStudent DESC, FM.FamilyMemberId) AS FAM
    WHERE    (@CampusId = 0
              OR COALESCE (CCS.CampusId, S.AdmissionCampusId) = @CampusId)
             AND (@AcademicYearId = 0
                  OR E.EnrollmentId IS NOT NULL)
             AND (@EnrolFilter IS NULL
                  OR E.EnrollmentId IS NOT NULL)
             AND (@ClassId = 0
                  OR CCS.ClassId = @ClassId)
             AND (@SectionId = 0
                  OR CCS.SectionId = @SectionId)
             AND (@GenderFilter IS NULL
                  OR UPPER(LEFT(LTRIM(S.Gender), 1)) = UPPER(LEFT(@GenderFilter, 1)))
             AND ((@StatusFilter IS NULL
                   AND (@IncludeFormerStudents = 1
                        OR S.Status = N'Active'))
                  OR (@StatusFilter IS NOT NULL
                      AND S.Status = @StatusFilter))
             AND (@AdmittedFrom IS NULL
                  OR S.AdmissionDate >= @AdmittedFrom)
             AND (@AdmittedTo IS NULL
                  OR S.AdmissionDat
e <= @AdmittedTo)
             AND (@SearchText IS NULL
                  OR S.StudentName LIKE N'%' + @SearchText + N'%'
                  OR S.FatherName LIKE N'%' + @SearchText + N'%'
                  OR S.RegistrationNumber LIKE N'%' + @SearchText + N'%'
                  OR S.AdmissionNumber = @SearchText)
    ORDER BY S.AdmissionNumberBase, S.AdmissionNumberSuffix, S.AdmissionId
    OPTION (RECOMPILE);
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.PostSelectedMonthlyFees
@UserId INT, @BillingMonth DATE, @Selection dbo.PostingSelectionType READONLY, @Reason NVARCHAR (500)=NULL, @AcademicYearId INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    EXECUTE dbo.RequirePermission @UserId, N'Fees.Collect';
    IF @BillingMonth IS NULL
        THROW 54720, 'A billing month is required. The month is a business decision and is never derived from today''s date.', 1;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                   FROM   @Selection)
        THROW 54721, 'No charges were selected to post.', 1;
    IF @AcademicYearId IS NULL OR @AcademicYearId<=0 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.AcademicYears WHERE AcademicYearId=@AcademicYearId)
        THROW 54743, 'Select a valid academic year before reviewing or posting fees.', 1;
    DECLARE @Month AS DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@BillingMonth), MONTH(@BillingMonth), 1);
    DECLARE @Remarks AS NVARCHAR (500) = LEFT(ISNULL(NULLIF (LTRIM(RTRIM(@Reason)), N''
), N'Manual fee posting (selected charges).'), 500);
    DECLARE @RowsRequested AS INT = (SELECT COUNT(*)
                                     FROM   @Selection);
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @Selection S JOIN dbo.Enrollments E WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) ON E.EnrollmentId=S.EnrollmentId WHERE E.AcademicYearId<>@AcademicYearId)
    BEGIN
        ROLLBACK;
        THROW 54744, 'Some selected enrollments belong to another academic year. Refresh the review; nothing was posted.', 1;
    END;
    DECLARE @CreatedCharges TABLE (
        BillingChargeId BIGINT PRIMARY KEY);
    INSERT dbo.BillingCharges (StudentFeeAssignmentId, EnrollmentId, AdmissionId, FeeTypeId, BillingMonth, ChargeDate, DueDate, GrossAmount, DiscountAmount, Remarks, ChargeKind)
    OUTPUT inserted.BillingChargeId INTO @CreatedCharges (BillingChargeId)
    SELECT SFA.StudentFeeAssignmentId,
           SFA.EnrollmentId,
           SFA.AdmissionId,
           SFA.FeeTypeId,
           @Month,
           @Month,
           @Month,
           SFA.Amount,
           SFA.DiscountAmount,
           @Remarks,
           N'Monthly'
    FROM   dbo.StudentFeeAssignments AS SFA
           INNER JOIN
           dbo.Enrollments AS E
           ON E.EnrollmentId = SFA.EnrollmentId
    WHERE  E.AcademicYearId = @AcademicYearId AND E.Status = N'Active'
           AND E.BillingReady = 1
           AND SFA.CancelledAt IS NULL
           AND SFA.Frequency = N'Monthly'
           AND @Month >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(ISNULL(E.BillingStartDate, E.EnrollmentDate)), MONTH(ISNULL(E.BillingStartDate, E.EnrollmentDate)), 1)
           AND (SFA.EffectiveFrom IS NULL
                OR @Month >= SFA.EffectiveFrom)
           AND (SFA.EffectiveTo IS NULL
                OR @Month <= SFA.EffectiveTo)
           AND (E.LeavingDate IS NULL
                OR DATEDIFF(MONTH, E.LeavingDate, @Month) <= 0)
           AND NOT (E.Status = N'Promot
ed'
                    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                FROM   dbo.Enrollments AS NX
                                WHERE  NX.AdmissionId = E.AdmissionId
                                       AND NX.EnrollmentId > E.EnrollmentId
                                       AND NX.BillingReady = 1
                                       AND NX.Status IN (N'Active', N'Promoted', N'Left')
                                       AND @Month >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(ISNULL(NX.BillingStartDate, NX.EnrollmentDate)), MONTH(ISNULL(NX.BillingStartDate, NX.EnrollmentDate)), 1)))
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                       FROM   @Selection AS S
                       WHERE  S.EnrollmentId = SFA.EnrollmentId
                              AND S.FeeTypeId = SFA.FeeTypeId
                              AND DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(S.BillingMonth), MONTH(S.BillingMonth), 1) = @Month)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                           FROM   dbo.BillingCharges AS BC
                           WHERE  BC.EnrollmentId = SFA.EnrollmentId
                                  AND BC.FeeTypeId = SFA.FeeTypeId
                                  AND BC.BillingMonth = @Month
                                  AND BC.ChargeKind = N'Monthly'
                                  AND BC.Status <> N'Cancelled');
    DECLARE @Created AS INT = @@ROWCOUNT;
    DECLARE @RowsNotPosted AS INT = @RowsRequested - @Created;
    IF @Created > 0
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @OperationId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NEWID();
            INSERT  dbo.AuditOperations (OperationId, UserId, OperationType, CorrelationNote)
            VALUES                     (@OperationId, @UserId, N'FEE_POSTING', N'BillingMonth=' + CONVERT (NVARCHAR (10), @Month, 120) + N'; Requested=' + CONVERT (NVARCHAR (10), @RowsRequested) + N'; Created=' + CONVERT (NVARCHAR (10), @Created));
            DECLARE @SummaryJson AS NVARCHAR (MAX) = (SELECT @Month AS BillingMonth,\
r
                                                             @RowsRequested AS RowsRequested,
                                                             @Created AS ChargesCreated,
                                                             @RowsNotPosted AS RowsNotPosted,
                                                             @Reason AS Reason,
                                                             N'Manual monthly fee posting of the selected charges. Each charge was created Open with no payment allocated.' AS Note
                                                      FOR    JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER, INCLUDE_NULL_VALUES);
            EXECUTE dbo.WriteAuditLog @OperationId = @OperationId, @UserId = @UserId, @TableName = N'BillingCharges', @RecordId = NULL, @Action = N'INSERT', @OldValues = NULL, @NewValues = @SummaryJson;
            DECLARE @ChargesJson AS NVARCHAR (MAX) = (SELECT BC.BillingChargeId AS BillingChargeId,
                                                             BC.StudentFeeAssignmentId AS StudentFeeAssignmentId,
                                                             BC.EnrollmentId AS EnrollmentId,
                                                             BC.AdmissionId AS AdmissionId,
                                                             BC.FeeTypeId AS FeeTypeId,
                                                             BC.BillingMonth AS BillingMonth,
                                                             BC.GrossAmount AS GrossAmount,
                                                             BC.DiscountAmount AS DiscountAmount,
                                                             BC.NetAmount AS NetAmount,
                                                             BC.Status AS Status
                                                      FROM   dbo.BillingCharges AS BC
                                                             INNER JOIN
                 
                                            @CreatedCharges AS C
                                                             ON C.BillingChargeId = BC.BillingChargeId
                                                      FOR    JSON PATH);
            IF @ChargesJson IS NOT NULL
                EXECUTE dbo.WriteAuditLog @OperationId = @OperationId, @UserId = @UserId, @TableName = N'BillingCharges', @RecordId = NULL, @Action = N'INSERT', @OldValues = NULL, @NewValues = @ChargesJson;
        END
    DELETE dbo.AuditOperations WHERE OperationId=@OperationId AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.AuditLogs WHERE OperationId=@OperationId);
COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    SELECT @Month AS BillingMonth,
           @RowsRequested AS RowsRequested,
           @Created AS ChargesCreated,
           @RowsNotPosted AS RowsNotPosted;
END

asCollectedMoney,

             ON C.ClassId = CCS.ClassId
             INNER JOIN
             dbo.Sections AS SEC
             ON SEC.SectionId = CCS.SectionId
             INNER JOIN
             dbo.FeeTypes AS FT
             ON FT.FeeTypeId = BC.FeeTypeId OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(A.Amount) AS Collected
                                                         FROM   dbo.FeePaymentAllocations AS A

                                                                ON FP.FeePaymentId = A.FeePaymentId
                                                                   AND FP.Status = N'Completed'

    WHERE    BC.BillingMonth = @Month AND E.Status=N'Active' AND E.Status=N'Active'
             AND BC.Status <> N'Cancelled'
             AND (@CampusId = 0
                  OR CCS.CampusId = @CampusId)
             AND (@ClassId = 0
                  OR CCS.ClassId = @ClassId)
             AND (@SectionId = 0
                  OR CCS.Sect
ionId = @SectionId)
             AND (@AnyFeeType = 0
                  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
                             FROM   @FeeTypeIds AS F
                             WHERE  F.FeeTypeId = BC.FeeTypeId))
    ORDER BY CAMP.CampusName, C.ClassName, SEC.SectionName, S.StudentName, FT.DisplayOrder, FT.FeeTypeName;
    WITH   C
    AS     (SELECT BC.BillingChargeId,
                   BC.AdmissionId,
                   BC.NetAmount,
                   ISNULL(PA.Collected, 0) AS Collected
            FROM   dbo.BillingCharges AS BC
                   INNER JOIN
                   dbo.Enrollments AS E
                   ON E.EnrollmentId = BC.EnrollmentId
                   INNER JOIN
                   dbo.CampusClassSections AS CCS
                   ON CCS.ClassSectionId = E.ClassSectionId OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(A.Amount) AS Collected
                                                                         FROM   dbo.FeePaymentAllocations AS A
                                                                                INNER JOIN
                                                                                dbo.FeePayments AS FP
                                                                                ON FP.FeePaymentId = A.FeePaymentId
                                                                                   AND FP.Status = N'Completed'
                                                                         WHERE  A.BillingChargeId = BC.BillingChargeId) AS PA
            WHERE  BC.BillingMonth = @Month AND E.Status=N'Active' AND E.Status=N'Active'
                   AND BC.Status <> N'Cancelled'
                   AND (@CampusId = 0
                        OR CCS.CampusId = @CampusId)
                   AND (@ClassId = 0
                        OR CCS.ClassId = @ClassId)
                   AND (@SectionId = 0
                        OR CCS.SectionId = @SectionId)
                 
  AND (@AnyFeeType = 0
                        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                   FROM   @FeeTypeIds AS F
                                   WHERE  F.FeeTypeId = BC.FeeTypeId)))
    SELECT @Month AS BillingMonth,
           COUNT(DISTINCT AdmissionId) AS StudentsAffected,
           COUNT(*) AS ChargesAffected,
           ISNULL(SUM(NetAmount), 0) AS TotalPosted,
           ISNULL(SUM(Collected), 0) AS TotalCollected,
           ISNULL(SUM(NetAmount - Collected), 0) AS TotalUncollected,
           SUM(CASE WHEN Collected = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ReversibleCharges,
           SUM(CASE WHEN Collected > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BlockedCharges,
           ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN Collected = 0 THEN NetAmount - Collected ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ReversibleAmount
    FROM   C;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.ReverseMonthlyFees
@UserId INT, @BillingMonth DATE, @Reason NVARCHAR (500), @CampusId INT=0, @ClassId INT=0, @SectionId INT=0, @FeeTypeIds dbo.FeeTypeIdList READONLY
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    EXECUTE dbo.RequirePermission @UserId, N'Fees.Collect';
    IF @BillingMonth IS NULL
        THROW 54740, 'A billing month is required.', 1;
    IF NULLIF (LTRIM(RTRIM(@Reason)), N'') IS NULL
        THROW 54741, 'A reason is required to reverse a fee posting.', 1;
    DECLARE @Month AS DATE = DATEFROMP
ARTS(YEAR(@BillingMonth), MONTH(@BillingMonth), 1);
    DECLARE @AnyFeeType AS BIT = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                                   FROM   @FeeTypeIds) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;
    DECLARE @Reversed TABLE (
        BillingChargeId BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
        AdmissionId     INT   );
    UPDATE BC
    SET    Status  = N'Cancelled',
           Remarks = LEFT(ISNULL(BC.Remarks + N' | ', N'') + N'Posting reversed: ' + @Reason, 500)
    OUTPUT inserted.BillingChargeId, inserted.AdmissionId INTO @Reversed (BillingChargeId, AdmissionId)
    FROM   dbo.BillingCharges AS BC
           INNER JOIN
           dbo.Enrollments AS E
           ON E.EnrollmentId = BC.EnrollmentId
           INNER JOIN
           dbo.CampusClassSections AS CCS
           ON CCS.ClassSectionId = E.ClassSectionId
    WHERE  BC.BillingMonth = @Month AND E.Status=N'Active' AND E.Status=N'Active'
           AND BC.Status <> N'Cancelled'
           AND (@CampusId = 0
                OR CCS.CampusId = @CampusId)
           AND (@ClassId = 0
                OR CCS.ClassId = @ClassId)
           AND (@SectionId = 0
                OR CCS.SectionId = @SectionId)
           AND (@AnyFeeType = 0
                OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
                           FROM   @FeeTypeIds AS F
                           WHERE  F.FeeTypeId = BC.FeeTypeId))
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                           FROM   dbo.FeePaymentAllocations AS A
                                  INNER JOIN
                                  dbo.FeePayments AS FP
                                  ON FP.FeePaymentId = A.FeePaymentId
                                     AND FP.Status = N'Completed'
                           WHERE  A.BillingChargeId = BC.BillingChargeId
                           HAVING SUM(A.Amount) > 0);
    DECLARE @ReversedCount AS INT = @@ROWCOUNT;
    IF @ReversedCount > 0
       
 BEGIN
            DECLARE @OperationId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NEWID();
            INSERT  dbo.AuditOperations (OperationId, UserId, OperationType, CorrelationNote)
            VALUES                     (@OperationId, @UserId, N'FEE_POSTING_REVERSAL', N'BillingMonth=' + CONVERT (NVARCHAR (10), @Month, 120) + N'; FeeTypes=' + CASE WHEN @AnyFeeType = 1 THEN N'selected' ELSE N'all' END);
            DECLARE @OldValues AS NVARCHAR (MAX) = (SELECT BC.BillingChargeId AS BillingChargeId,
                                                           BC.StudentFeeAssignmentId AS StudentFeeAssignmentId,
                                                           BC.EnrollmentId AS EnrollmentId,
                                                           BC.AdmissionId AS AdmissionId,
                                                           BC.FeeTypeId AS FeeTypeId,
                                                           BC.BillingMonth AS BillingMonth,
                                                           BC.GrossAmount AS GrossAmount,
                                                           BC.DiscountAmount AS DiscountAmount,
                                                           BC.NetAmount AS NetAmount,
                                                           BC.Status AS Status
                                                    FROM   dbo.BillingCharges AS BC
                                                           INNER JOIN
                                                           @Reversed AS R
                                                           ON R.BillingChargeId = BC.BillingChargeId
                                                    FOR    JSON PATH);
            DECLARE @NewValues AS NVARCHAR (MAX) = (SELECT @Month AS BillingMonth,
                                                           @ReversedCount AS ChargesReversed,
                                                           N'Cancelled' AS Status,\
r
                                                           @Reason AS Reason,
                                                           N'Uncollected posting reversed; no payment was allocated to any of these charges.' AS Note
                                                    FOR    JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER, INCLUDE_NULL_VALUES);
            EXECUTE dbo.WriteAuditLog @OperationId = @OperationId, @UserId = @UserId, @TableName = N'BillingCharges', @RecordId = NULL, @Action = N'UPDATE', @OldValues = @OldValues, @NewValues = @NewValues;
        END
    DELETE dbo.AuditOperations WHERE OperationId=@OperationId AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.AuditLogs WHERE OperationId=@OperationId);
COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    SELECT   BC.BillingChargeId,
             BC.AdmissionId,
             S.StudentName,
             FT.FeeTypeName,
             BC.NetAmount,
             ISNULL(PA.Collected, 0) AS CollectedAmount,
             N'This fee has already been collected. It cannot be reversed as an uncollected posting - use Fee Collection Correction/Refund/Reversal.' AS ActionRequired
    FROM     dbo.BillingCharges AS BC
             INNER JOIN
             dbo.Students AS S
             ON S.AdmissionId = BC.AdmissionId
             INNER JOIN
             dbo.FeeTypes AS FT
             ON FT.FeeTypeId = BC.FeeTypeId
             INNER JOIN
             dbo.Enrollments AS E
             ON E.EnrollmentId = BC.EnrollmentId
             INNER JOIN
             dbo.CampusClassSections AS CCS
             ON CCS.ClassSectionId = E.ClassSectionId OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(A.Amount) AS Collected
                                                                   FROM   dbo.FeePaymentAllocations AS A
                                                                          INNER JOIN
                                                                          dbo.FeePayments AS FP
                                               
                           ON FP.FeePaymentId = A.FeePaymentId
                                                                             AND FP.Status = N'Completed'
                                                                   WHERE  A.BillingChargeId = BC.BillingChargeId) AS PA
    WHERE    BC.BillingMonth = @Month AND E.Status=N'Active' AND E.Status=N'Active'
             AND BC.Status <> N'Cancelled'
             AND (@CampusId = 0
                  OR CCS.CampusId = @CampusId)
             AND (@ClassId = 0
                  OR CCS.ClassId = @ClassId)
             AND (@SectionId = 0
                  OR CCS.SectionId = @SectionId)
             AND (@AnyFeeType = 0
                  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
                             FROM   @FeeTypeIds AS F
                             WHERE  F.FeeTypeId = BC.FeeTypeId))
             AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM   dbo.FeePaymentAllocations AS A
                                INNER JOIN
                                dbo.FeePayments AS FP
                                ON FP.FeePaymentId = A.FeePaymentId
                                   AND FP.Status = N'Completed'
                         WHERE  A.BillingChargeId = BC.BillingChargeId
                         HAVING SUM(A.Amount) > 0)
    ORDER BY S.StudentName, FT.FeeTypeName;
    SELECT @Month AS BillingMonth,
           @ReversedCount AS ChargesReversed,
           (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT AdmissionId)
            FROM   @Reversed) AS StudentsAffected,
           (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(BC.NetAmount), 0)
            FROM   dbo.BillingCharges AS BC
                   INNER JOIN
                   @Reversed AS R
                   ON R.BillingChargeId = BC.BillingChargeId) AS ReversedAmount;
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.UpdateProvisionalCertificate
@UserId INT, @ProvisionalCertificateId INT, @ExamType NVARCHAR (10), @ExamYear INT, @Boa
rdName NVARCHAR (150), @RollNumber NVARCHAR (30), @MarksObtained INT, @MarksOutOf INT, @Grade NVARCHAR (10), @OtherSubjects NVARCHAR (300), @CertificateDate DATE, @SubjectIds NVARCHAR (MAX)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    EXECUTE dbo.RequirePermission @UserId, N'Certificates.Create';
    IF @ProvisionalCertificateId <= 0
        THROW 58820, 'A valid certificate is required.', 1;
    IF @ExamType NOT IN (N'SSC', N'HSSC1', N'HSSC2')
        THROW 58821, 'A valid exam type is required.', 1;
    IF @ExamYear IS NULL
       OR @ExamYear < 1990
       OR @ExamYear > YEAR(SYSDATETIME()) + 1
        THROW 58822, 'A valid exam year is required.', 1;
    IF @BoardName IS NULL
       OR LTRIM(RTRIM(@BoardName)) = N''
        THROW 58823, 'Board name is required.', 1;
    IF @RollNumber IS NULL
       OR LTRIM(RTRIM(@RollNumber)) = N''
        THROW 58824, 'Roll number is required.', 1;
    IF @MarksObtained IS NULL
       OR @MarksObtained < 0
        THROW 58825, 'Marks obtained is required.', 1;
    IF @MarksOutOf IS NULL
       OR @MarksOutOf <= 0
        THROW 58826, 'Marks out of is required.', 1;
    IF @MarksObtained > @MarksOutOf
        THROW 58827, 'Marks obtained cannot exceed marks out of.', 1;
    IF @CertificateDate IS NULL
        THROW 58828, 'Certificate date is required.', 1;
    IF @CertificateDate > CONVERT (DATE, SYSDATETIME())
        THROW 58829, 'Certificate date cannot be in the future.', 1;
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;
    DECLARE @AdmissionId AS INT;
    DECLARE @OldValues AS NVARCHAR (MAX);
    SELECT @AdmissionId = PC.AdmissionId,
           @OldValues = (SELECT PC.ProvisionalCertificateId,
                                PC.AdmissionId,
                                PC.ExamType,
                                PC.ExamYear,
                                PC.BoardName,
                                PC.RollNumber,
                
                PC.MarksObtained,
                                PC.MarksOutOf,
                                PC.Grade,
                                PC.OtherSubjects,
                                PC.CertificateDate,
                                JSON_QUERY((SELECT   SubjectId,
                                                     SubjectName,
                                                     DisplayOrder
                                            FROM     dbo.ProvisionalCertificateSubjects
                                            WHERE    ProvisionalCertificateId = @ProvisionalCertificateId
                                            ORDER BY DisplayOrder, SubjectId
                                            FOR      JSON PATH)) AS Subjects
                         FOR    JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER, INCLUDE_NULL_VALUES)
    FROM   dbo.ProvisionalCertificates AS PC WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
    WHERE  PC.ProvisionalCertificateId = @ProvisionalCertificateId;
    IF @AdmissionId IS NULL
        THROW 58830, 'The certificate was not found.', 1;
    UPDATE dbo.ProvisionalCertificates
    SET    ExamType        = @ExamType,
           ExamYear        = @ExamYear,
           BoardName       = LTRIM(RTRIM(@BoardName)),
           RollNumber      = LTRIM(RTRIM(@RollNumber)),
           MarksObtained   = @MarksObtained,
           MarksOutOf      = @MarksOutOf,
           Grade           = NULLIF (LTRIM(RTRIM(@Grade)), N''),
           OtherSubjects   = NULLIF (LTRIM(RTRIM(@OtherSubjects)), N''),
           CertificateDate = @CertificateDate,
           UpdatedByUserId = @UserId,
           UpdatedAt       = SYSDATETIME()
    WHERE  ProvisionalCertificateId = @ProvisionalCertificateId;
    DECLARE @SavedSubjectOrder TABLE (
        SubjectId    INT,
        DisplayOrder INT);
    INSERT @SavedSubjectOrder
    SELECT SubjectId,
           DisplayOrder
    FROM   dbo.ProvisionalCer
tificateSubjects
    WHERE  ProvisionalCertificateId = @ProvisionalCertificateId;
    DELETE dbo.ProvisionalCertificateSubjects
    WHERE  ProvisionalCertificateId = @ProvisionalCertificateId;
    IF @SubjectIds IS NOT NULL
       AND LTRIM(RTRIM(@SubjectIds)) <> N''
        BEGIN
            INSERT dbo.ProvisionalCertificateSubjects (ProvisionalCertificateId, SubjectId, SubjectName, DisplayOrder)
            SELECT @ProvisionalCertificateId,
                   SU.SubjectId,
                   SU.SubjectName,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE (SO.DisplayOrder, 2147483647), SU.SubjectName, SU.SubjectId)
            FROM   STRING_SPLIT (@SubjectIds, N',') AS SPL
                   INNER JOIN
                   dbo.Subjects AS SU
                   ON SU.SubjectId = TRY_CONVERT (INT, LTRIM(RTRIM(SPL.value)))
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN
                   @SavedSubjectOrder AS SO
                   ON SO.SubjectId = SU.SubjectId
            WHERE  TRY_CONVERT (INT, LTRIM(RTRIM(SPL.value))) IS NOT NULL;
        END
    DECLARE @OperationId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NEWID();
    DECLARE @RecordId AS NVARCHAR (200) = CONVERT (NVARCHAR (200), @ProvisionalCertificateId);
    DECLARE @NewValues AS NVARCHAR (MAX);
    SELECT @NewValues = (SELECT ProvisionalCertificateId,
                                AdmissionId,
                                ExamType,
                                ExamYear,
                                BoardName,
                                RollNumber,
                                MarksObtained,
                                MarksOutOf,
                                Grade,
                                OtherSubjects,
                                CertificateDate,
                                JSON_QUERY((SELECT   SubjectId,
                                                     SubjectName,
                                            
         DisplayOrder
                                            FROM     dbo.ProvisionalCertificateSubjects
                                            WHERE    ProvisionalCertificateId = @ProvisionalCertificateId
                                            ORDER BY DisplayOrder, SubjectId
                                            FOR      JSON PATH)) AS Subjects
                         FROM   dbo.ProvisionalCertificates
                         WHERE  ProvisionalCertificateId = @ProvisionalCertificateId
                         FOR    JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER, INCLUDE_NULL_VALUES);
    INSERT  dbo.AuditOperations (OperationId, UserId, OperationType, CorrelationNote)
    VALUES                     (@OperationId, @UserId, N'PROVISIONAL_CERTIFICATE', CONVERT (NVARCHAR (200), @AdmissionId));
    EXECUTE dbo.WriteAuditLog @OperationId = @OperationId, @UserId = @UserId, @TableName = N'ProvisionalCertificates', @RecordId = @RecordId, @Action = N'UPDATE', @OldValues = @OldValues, @NewValues = @NewValues;
    DELETE dbo.AuditOperations WHERE OperationId=@OperationId AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.AuditLogs WHERE OperationId=@OperationId);
COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    SELECT @ProvisionalCertificateId AS ProvisionalCertificateId,
           @AdmissionId AS AdmissionId;
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.GetProvisionalCertificatePrintData
@UserId INT, @ProvisionalCertificateId INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXECUTE dbo.RequirePermission @UserId, N'Certificates.Print';
    IF @ProvisionalCertificateId <= 0
        THROW 58840, 'A valid certificate is required.', 1;
    DECLARE @OtherSubjects AS NVARCHAR (300);
    DECLARE @PickedCount AS INT;
    SELECT @OtherSubjects = PC.OtherSubjects
    FROM   dbo.ProvisionalCertificates AS PC
    WHERE  PC.ProvisionalCertificateId = @ProvisionalCertificateId;
    SELECT @PickedCount = COUNT(*)
    FROM   dbo.ProvisionalCertificateSubjects
    WHERE  ProvisionalCertificateId = @ProvisionalCertificateId;
    DECLARE @SubjectsPassedLine AS NVARCHAR (MAX);
    WITH   PickedSubjects
    AS     (SELECT PCS.SubjectName,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY PCS.DisplayOrder, PCS.SubjectName) AS Seq
            FROM   dbo.ProvisionalCertificateSubjects AS PCS
            WHERE  PCS.ProvisionalCertificateId = @ProvisionalCertificateId),
           OtherSubjectsList
    AS     (SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(SPL.value)) AS SubjectName,
                  
 @PickedCount + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS Seq
            FROM   STRING_SPLIT (COALESCE (@OtherSubjects, N''), N',') AS SPL
            WHERE  LTRIM(RTRIM(SPL.value)) <> N''),
           AllSubjects
    AS     (SELECT SubjectName,
                   Seq
            FROM   PickedSubjects
            UNION ALL
            SELECT SubjectName,
                   Seq
            FROM   OtherSubjectsList)
    SELECT @SubjectsPassedLine = STRING_AGG(CONCAT(N'(', Seq, N')  ', SubjectName), N'   ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY Seq)
    FROM   AllSubjects;
    SELECT PC.ProvisionalCertificateId,
           PC.AdmissionId,
           PC.CertificateNumber AS CertificateNumber,
           PC.StudentName,
           PC.FatherName,
           PC.Gender,
           PC.DateOfBirth,
           dbo.fn_DateToWords(PC.DateOfBirth) AS DateOfBirthWords,
           PC.ExamType,
           CASE PC.ExamType WHEN N'SSC' THEN N'Secondary School Certificate' WHEN N'HSSC1' THEN N'Higher Secondary School Certificate Part-I' WHEN N'HSSC2' THEN N'Higher Secondary School Certificate Part-II' END AS ExamTypeLabel,
           PC.ExamYear,
           PC.BoardName,
           PC.RollNumber,
           PC.MarksObtained,
           PC.MarksOutOf,
           PC.Grade,
           COALESCE (@SubjectsPassedLine, N'') AS SubjectsPassedLine,
           PC.CertificateDate,
           PC.CreatedAt AS DateOfIssue,
           SP.SchoolName AS InstitutionLine
    FROM   dbo.ProvisionalCertificates AS PC CROSS JOIN dbo.SchoolProfile AS SP
    WHERE  PC.ProvisionalCertificateId = @ProvisionalCertificateId
           AND SP.SchoolProfileId = 1;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.GetStudentsAffectedByFeeConfiguration

AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXEC dbo.RequirePermission @UserId, N'Fees.Configuration.Manage';

    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM dbo.FeeConfigurations
        WHERE CampusId = @CampusId AND ClassId = @ClassId AND FeeTypeId = @FeeType
Id
    )
        THROW 53150, 'No fee configuration exists for the selected campus, class and fee type.', 1;

    SELECT
        X.StudentFeeAssignmentId,

        CL.ClassName,
        SEC.SectionName,
        X.CurrentAmount,
        X.NewAmount,
        X.CurrentFrequency,
        X.ConfiguredFrequency,
        X.AssignmentEffectiveFrom,
        (                                                            -- Hardening pass, Step 2
            SELECT MAX(BC.BillingMonth) FROM dbo.BillingCharges BC

1)* FROM dbo.DailyCollectionClosings

             LEFT OUTER JOIN
             dbo.CampusClassSections AS CCS

             LEFT OUTER JOIN

             LEFT OUTER JOIN

             LEFT OUTER JOIN
             dbo.Sections AS SEC

             dbo.AcademicPrograms AS AP

CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.GetSetupReadiness

AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    DECLARE @Setup AS BIT = 0, @Fees AS BIT = 0, @Calendar AS BIT = 0;
    BEGIN TRY
        EXECUTE dbo.RequirePermission @UserId, N'System.Setup';
        SET @Setup = 1;

    BEGIN CATCH

            THROW;
    END CATCH
    BEGIN TRY

    END TRY

        SET @Calendar = 1;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 50003
            THROW;
    END CATCH
    IF @Setup = 0
       AND @Fees = 0
       AND @Calendar = 0
        THROW 50003, 'Setup access is required.', 1;
    DECLARE @Issues TABLE (
        Area    NVARCHAR (50) ,
      
  Issue   NVARCHAR (500),
        PageKey NVARCHAR (40) );
    IF @Setup = 1
        BEGIN
            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                           FROM   dbo.SchoolProfile
                           WHERE  NULLIF (LTRIM(RTRIM(SchoolName)), N'') IS NOT NULL
                                  AND NULLIF (LTRIM(RTRIM(AddressLine)), N'') IS NOT NULL
                                  AND NULLIF (LTRIM(RTRIM(ContactNumber)), N'') IS NOT NULL)
                INSERT  @Issues
                VALUES (N'School profile', N'Complete the school name, address and contact number used on documents.', N'Profile');
            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                           FROM   dbo.Campuses)
                INSERT  @Issues
                VALUES (N'Campuses', N'Add an campus.', N'Campuses');
            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                           FROM   dbo.CampusClassSections AS CCS
                                  INNER JOIN
                                  dbo.Campuses AS C
                                  ON C.CampusId = CCS.CampusId
                                  INNER JOIN
                                  dbo.Classes AS CL
                                  ON CL.ClassId = CCS.ClassId
                                  INNER JOIN
                                  dbo.Sections AS S
                                  ON S.SectionId = CCS.SectionId)
                INSERT  @Issues
                VALUES (N'Placement', N'Assign classes and sections to an campus.', N'Assignments');
        END
    IF @Calendar = 1
       AND (SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM   dbo.AcademicYears
            WHERE  IsCurrent = 1
                   AND CONVERT (DATE, GETDATE()) BETWEEN StartDate AND EndDate) <> 1
        INSERT  @Issues
        VALUES (N'Academic year', N'Select one current academic year covering today.', N'Years');
    IF @Fees = 1
        BEGIN
            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1

                           FROM   dbo.FeeTypes
                           WHERE  IsMandatory = 1
                                  AND IsTransportLinked = 0)
                INSERT  @Issues
                VALUES (N'Fee types', N'No mandatory non-transport fee type is configured. Confirm this is intentional.', N'Fees');
            INSERT @Issues
            SELECT DISTINCT N'Fee rates',
                            CONCAT(C.CampusName, N' / ', CL.ClassName, N': configure ', FT.FeeTypeName, N' (zero is allowed for an intentionally free fee).'),
                            N'Fees'
            FROM   dbo.CampusClassSections AS CCS
                   INNER JOIN
                   dbo.Campuses AS C
                   ON C.CampusId = CCS.CampusId
                   INNER JOIN
                   dbo.Classes AS CL
                   ON CL.ClassId = CCS.ClassId
                   INNER JOIN
                   dbo.Sections AS S
                   ON S.SectionId = CCS.SectionId CROSS JOIN dbo.FeeTypes AS FT
            WHERE  FT.IsMandatory = 1
                   AND FT.IsTransportLinked = 0
                   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                   FROM   dbo.FeeConfigurations AS FC
                                   WHERE  FC.CampusId = CCS.CampusId
                                          AND FC.ClassId = CCS.ClassId
                                          AND FC.FeeTypeId = FT.FeeTypeId
                                          AND FC.Amount >= 0);
        END
    SELECT   Area,
             Issue,
             PageKey
    FROM     @Issues
    ORDER BY Area, Issue;
END

       (N'Day', N'Week', N'Month', N'Payment Method', N'Class', N'Campus', N'Fee Type')

    IF @FromDate IS NOT NULL AND @ToDate IS NOT NULL AND @FromDate > @ToDate
        THROW 59903, 'The collections report date range is invalid.', 1;

    SELECT FP.FeePaymentId, FP.ReceiptNumber,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(FP.ReceiptNumber, N''), CONCAT(N'PAYMENT-', FP.FeePaymentId)) ReceiptKey,
           FP.PaymentDate, FP.PaymentMethod, FP.ReferenceNumber, FP.TotalAmount,
           FP.RelatedFeePaymentId, FP.IsGroupPayment, FP.AdmissionId,

           U.Username ReceivedBy
    INTO #Payments

    JOIN dbo.Students S ON S.AdmissionId = FP.AdmissionId
    JOIN dbo.Enrollments E ON E.EnrollmentId = FP.EnrollmentId AND E.AdmissionId = FP.AdmissionId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.CampusClassSections CCS ON CCS.ClassSectionId = E.ClassSectionId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Campuses CAMP ON CAMP.CampusId = CCS.CampusId
  
  LEFT JOIN dbo.Classes C ON C.ClassId = CCS.ClassId
