      AND (@CampusId = 0 OR CCS.CampusId = @CampusId)
      AND (@ClassId = 0 OR CCS.ClassId = @ClassId)
      AND (@SectionId = 0 OR CCS.SectionId = @SectionId)
      AND (@PaymentMethod IS NULL OR FP.PaymentMethod = @PaymentMethod);

    IF @View = N'Receipts'
    BEGIN
        SELECT MAX(ReceiptNumber) [Receipt No.], MIN(PaymentDate) [Date],
               CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT AdmissionId) > 1 THEN N'Family receipt'
                    ELSE MAX(StudentName) END [Student / Family],
               CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ClassName) > 1 THEN N'Multiple' ELSE MAX(ClassName) END [Class],
               CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT PaymentMethod) > 1 THEN N'Mixed' ELSE MAX(PaymentMethod) END [Payment Method],
               SUM(CASE WHEN TotalAmount > 0 THEN TotalAmount ELSE 0 END) [Gross Received],
               -SUM(CASE WHEN TotalAmount < 0 AND PaymentMethod = N'Refund' THEN TotalAmount ELSE 0 END) [Refunds],
               -SUM(CASE WHEN TotalAmount < 0 AND PaymentMethod = N'Correction' THEN TotalAmount ELSE 0 END) [Corrections],
               SUM(TotalAmount) [Net Amount], MAX(ReceivedBy) [Received By]
        FROM #Payments GROUP BY ReceiptKey ORDER BY MIN(PaymentDate), MAX(ReceiptNumber);
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ReceiptKey) Receipts,
               COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN TotalAmount > 0 THEN TotalAmount ELSE 0 END), 0) [Gross Received],
               -COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN TotalAmount < 0 AND PaymentMethod = N'Refund' THEN TotalAmount ELSE 0 END), 0) Refunds,
               -COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN TotalAmount < 0 AND PaymentMethod = N'Correction' THEN TotalAmount ELSE 0 END), 0) Corrections,
               COALESCE(SUM(TotalAmount), 0) [Net
 Collection] FROM #Payments;
        RETURN;
    END;

    IF @View = N'Detailed Transactions'
    BEGIN
        SELECT P.ReceiptNumber [Receipt No.], P.PaymentDate [Date],
               COALESCE(CS.StudentName, P.StudentName) [Student],
               FT.FeeTypeName [Fee Type], COALESCE(CONVERT(nvarchar(20), BC.BillingMonth, 106), BC.Remarks) [Charge / Month],
               FPA.Amount [Amount], P.PaymentMethod [Payment Method],
               OP.ReceiptNumber [Original Receipt], P.ReferenceNumber [Reference]
        FROM #Payments P
        LEFT JOIN dbo.FeePaymentAllocations FPA ON FPA.FeePaymentId = P.FeePaymentId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.BillingCharges BC ON BC.BillingChargeId = FPA.BillingChargeId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.Students CS ON CS.AdmissionId = BC.AdmissionId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.FeeTypes FT ON FT.FeeTypeId = BC.FeeTypeId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.FeePayments OP ON OP.FeePaymentId = P.RelatedFeePaymentId
        ORDER BY P.PaymentDate, P.ReceiptNumber, FPA.FeePaymentAllocationId;
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ReceiptKey) Receipts,
               COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN TotalAmount > 0 THEN TotalAmount ELSE 0 END), 0) [Gross Received],
               -COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN TotalAmount < 0 AND PaymentMethod = N'Refund' THEN TotalAmount ELSE 0 END), 0) Refunds,
               -COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN TotalAmount < 0 AND PaymentMethod = N'Correction' THEN TotalAmount ELSE 0 END), 0) Corrections,
               COALESCE(SUM(TotalAmount), 0) [Net Collection] FROM #Payments;
        RETURN;
    END;

    IF @GroupBy = N'Fee Type'
    BEGIN
        SELECT COALESCE(FT.FeeTypeName, N'Unallocated') [Group],
               COUNT(DISTINCT P.ReceiptKey) [Receipts],
               COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN FPA.Amount > 0 THEN FPA.Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) [Gross Received],
               -COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN FPA.Amount < 0 AND P.PaymentMethod = N'Refund' THEN FPA.Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) [Refunds],
               -COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN FPA.Amount < 0 AND P.PaymentMethod = N'Corr
ection' THEN FPA.Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) [Corrections],
               COALESCE(SUM(FPA.Amount), 0) [Net Collection]
        FROM #Payments P
        LEFT JOIN dbo.FeePaymentAllocations FPA ON FPA.FeePaymentId = P.FeePaymentId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.BillingCharges BC ON BC.BillingChargeId = FPA.BillingChargeId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.FeeTypes FT ON FT.FeeTypeId = BC.FeeTypeId
        GROUP BY COALESCE(FT.FeeTypeName, N'Unallocated')
        ORDER BY [Group];
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        ;WITH S AS
        (
            SELECT CASE @GroupBy
                     WHEN N'Week' THEN CONCAT(CONVERT(char(10), DATEADD(day, -(DATEDIFF(day, 0, PaymentDate) % 7), PaymentDate), 23), N' week')
                     WHEN N'Month' THEN CONVERT(char(7), PaymentDate, 126)
                     WHEN N'Payment Method' THEN PaymentMethod
                     WHEN N'Class' THEN COALESCE(ClassName, N'Unassigned')
                     WHEN N'Campus' THEN COALESCE(CampusName, N'Unassigned')
                     ELSE CONVERT(char(10), PaymentDate, 23) END [Group],
                   ReceiptKey, TotalAmount, PaymentMethod
            FROM #Payments
        )
        SELECT [Group], COUNT(DISTINCT ReceiptKey) [Receipts],
               COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN TotalAmount > 0 THEN TotalAmount ELSE 0 END), 0) [Gross Received],
               -COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN TotalAmount < 0 AND PaymentMethod = N'Refund' THEN TotalAmount ELSE 0 END), 0) [Refunds],
               -COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN TotalAmount < 0 AND PaymentMethod = N'Correction' THEN TotalAmount ELSE 0 END), 0) [Corrections],
               COALESCE(SUM(TotalAmount), 0) [Net Collection]
        FROM S GROUP BY [Group] ORDER BY [Group];
    END;

    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ReceiptKey) Receipts,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN TotalAmount > 0 THEN TotalAmount ELSE 0 END), 0) [Gross Received],
           -COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN TotalAmount < 0 AND PaymentMethod = N'Refund' THEN TotalAmount ELSE 0 END), 0) Refunds,
           -COALESCE
(SUM(CASE WHEN TotalAmount < 0 AND PaymentMethod = N'Correction' THEN TotalAmount ELSE 0 END), 0) Corrections,
           COALESCE(SUM(TotalAmount), 0) [Net Collection] FROM #Payments;
END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.GetOutstandingAndAgingReport
    @UserId int,
    @View nvarchar(20),
    @CampusId int = 0,
    @AcademicYearId int = 0,
    @ClassId int = 0,
    @SectionId int = 0,
    @AsOfDate date = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.RequirePermission @UserId, N'Reports.View';
    SET @AsOfDate = COALESCE(@AsOfDate, CONVERT(date, SYSDATETIME()));

    SELECT BC.BillingChargeId, BC.AdmissionId, S.RegistrationNumber, S.AdmissionNumber, S.StudentName,
           CAMP.CampusName, C.ClassName, SEC.SectionName, FT.FeeTypeName,
           BC.BillingMonth, BC.ChargeDate, BC.DueDate, BC.GrossAmount, BC.DiscountAmount,
           BC.NetAmount, BC.NetAmount - B.Balance PaidAmount, B.Balance Outstanding,
           CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(day, BC.DueDate, @AsOfDate) <= 0 THEN N'Not Yet Due'
                WHEN DATEDIFF(day, BC.DueDate, @AsOfDate) <= 30 THEN N'1-30 days'
                WHEN DATEDIFF(day, BC.DueDate, @AsOfDate) <= 60 THEN N'31-60 days'
                WHEN DATEDIFF(day, BC.DueDate, @AsOfDate) <= 90 THEN N'61-90 days'
                ELSE N'90+ days' END Ag
ingBucket
    INTO #Charges
    FROM dbo.BillingCharges BC
    CROSS APPLY (SELECT dbo.GetFeeChargeBalance(BC.BillingChargeId) Balance) B
    JOIN dbo.Students S ON S.AdmissionId = BC.AdmissionId
    JOIN dbo.Enrollments E ON E.EnrollmentId = BC.EnrollmentId
    JOIN dbo.CampusClassSections CCS ON CCS.ClassSectionId = E.ClassSectionId
    JOIN dbo.Campuses CAMP ON CAMP.CampusId = CCS.CampusId
    JOIN dbo.Classes C ON C.ClassId = CCS.ClassId
    JOIN dbo.Sections SEC ON SEC.SectionId = CCS.SectionId
    JOIN dbo.FeeTypes FT ON FT.FeeTypeId = BC.FeeTypeId
    WHERE BC.Status <> N'Cancelled' AND B.Balance > 0
      AND (@CampusId = 0 OR CCS.CampusId = @CampusId)
      AND (@AcademicYearId = 0 OR E.AcademicYearId = @AcademicYearId)
      AND (@ClassId = 0 OR CCS.ClassId = @ClassId)
      AND (@SectionId = 0 OR CCS.SectionId = @SectionId);

    IF @View = N'Charges'
    BEGIN
        SELECT AdmissionNumber [Admission Number], StudentName [Student], ClassName [Class], FeeTypeName [Fee Type],
               BillingMonth [Charge Month], ChargeDate [Charge Date], DueDate [Due Date], GrossAmount [Original Amount],
               DiscountAmount [Discount], NetAmount [Net Charge], PaidAmount [Paid], Outstanding, AgingBucket [Aging]
        FROM #Charges ORDER BY StudentName, DueDate, BillingChargeId;
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT AdmissionId) [Students Owing], SUM(Outstanding) [Total Outstanding],
               SUM(CASE WHEN DueDate < @AsOfDate THEN Outstanding ELSE 0 END) Overdue,
               SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(day, DueDate, @AsOfDate) > 90 THEN Outstanding ELSE 0 END) [90+ Days] FROM #Charges;
        RETURN;
    END;
    IF @View = N'Aging'
    BEGIN
        SELECT AgingBucket [Aging Bucket], COUNT(DISTINCT AdmissionId) [Students], COUNT(*) [Charges], SUM(Outstanding) [Outstanding]
        FROM #Charges GROUP BY AgingBucket
        ORDER BY CASE AgingBucket WHEN N'Not Yet Due' THEN 0 WHEN N'1-30 days' TH
EN 1 WHEN N'31-60 days' THEN 2 WHEN N'61-90 days' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END;
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT AdmissionId) [Students Owing], SUM(Outstanding) [Total Outstanding],
               SUM(CASE WHEN DueDate < @AsOfDate THEN Outstanding ELSE 0 END) Overdue,
               SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(day, DueDate, @AsOfDate) > 90 THEN Outstanding ELSE 0 END) [90+ Days] FROM #Charges;
        RETURN;
    END;
    IF @View = N'Families'
    BEGIN
        ;WITH Members AS
        (
            SELECT AdmissionId, MAX(StudentName) StudentName, SUM(Outstanding) Outstanding, MIN(DueDate) OldestDueDate
            FROM #Charges GROUP BY AdmissionId
        )
        SELECT F.FamilyCode [Family], COUNT(*) [Students], STRING_AGG(M.StudentName, N', ') [Members],
               SUM(M.Outstanding) [Outstanding], MIN(M.OldestDueDate) [Oldest Due Date]
        FROM Members M JOIN dbo.FamilyMembers FM ON FM.AdmissionId = M.AdmissionId
        JOIN dbo.Families F ON F.FamilyId = FM.FamilyId
        GROUP BY F.FamilyId, F.FamilyCode ORDER BY SUM(M.Outstanding) DESC;
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT C.AdmissionId) [Students Owing], SUM(C.Outstanding) [Total Outstanding],
               SUM(CASE WHEN C.DueDate < @AsOfDate THEN C.Outstanding ELSE 0 END) Overdue,
               SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(day, C.DueDate, @AsOfDate) > 90 THEN C.Outstanding ELSE 0 END) [90+ Days]
        FROM #Charges C JOIN dbo.FamilyMembers FM ON FM.AdmissionId = C.AdmissionId;
        RETURN;
    END;
    SELECT AdmissionNumber [Admission Number], StudentName [Student], ClassName [Class],
           SUM(NetAmount) [Total Charges], SUM(PaidAmount) [Amount Paid], SUM(Outstanding) [Outstanding],
           MIN(DueDate) [Oldest Due Date],
           CASE WHEN MAX(DATEDIFF(day, DueDate, @AsOfDate)) > 90 THEN N'90+ days'
                WHEN MAX(DATEDIFF(day, DueDate, @AsOfDate)) > 60 THEN N'61-90 days'
                WHEN MAX(DATEDIFF(day, DueDate, @AsOfDate)) > 30 THEN
 N'31-60 days'
                WHEN MAX(DATEDIFF(day, DueDate, @AsOfDate)) > 0 THEN N'1-30 days' ELSE N'Not Yet Due' END [Aging]
    FROM #Charges GROUP BY AdmissionId, RegistrationNumber, AdmissionNumber, StudentName, ClassName
    ORDER BY SUM(Outstanding) DESC;
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT AdmissionId) [Students Owing], SUM(Outstanding) [Total Outstanding],
           SUM(CASE WHEN DueDate < @AsOfDate THEN Outstanding ELSE 0 END) Overdue,
           SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(day, DueDate, @AsOfDate) > 90 THEN Outstanding ELSE 0 END) [90+ Days] FROM #Charges;
END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.SaveAcademicYear
@AcademicYearId INT, @YearName NVARCHAR 
(50), @StartDate DATE, @EndDate DATE, @IsCurrent BIT, @Remarks NVARCHAR (500), @UserId INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    EXECUTE dbo.RequirePermission @UserId, N'Calendar.Manage';
    IF NULLIF (LTRIM(RTRIM(@YearName)), N'') IS NULL
        THROW 56110, 'Academic year name is required.', 1;
    IF @EndDate < @StartDate
        THROW 56111, 'Academic year end date cannot be earlier than its start date.', 1;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1
               FROM   dbo.AcademicYears
               WHERE  YearName = LTRIM(RTRIM(@YearName))
                      AND AcademicYearId <> @AcademicYearId)
        THROW 56112, 'An academic year with this name already exists.', 1;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1
               FROM   dbo.AcademicYears
               WHERE  AcademicYearId <> @AcademicYearId
                      AND StartDate <= @EndDate
                      AND EndDate >= @StartDate)
        THROW 56115, 'These dates overlap an existing academic year. Academic years cannot cover the same calendar dates; adjust the start or end date. (Touching years are allowed: one may end the day before the next begins.)', 1;
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;
    IF @IsCurrent = 1
        UPDATE dbo.AcademicYears
        SET    IsCurrent = 0,
               UpdatedAt = SYSDATETIME()
        WHERE  AcademicYearId <> @AcademicYearId
               AND IsCurrent = 1;
    IF @AcademicYearId = 0
        BEGIN
            INSERT  dbo.AcademicYears (YearName, StartDate, EndDate, IsCurrent, Remarks)
            VALUES                   (LTRIM(RTRIM(@YearName)), @StartDate, @EndDate, @IsCurrent, NULLIF (LTRIM(RTRIM(@Remarks)), N''));
            SELECT CONVERT (INT, SCOPE_IDENTITY()) AS AcademicYearId;
        END
    ELSE
        BEGIN
            UPDATE dbo.AcademicYears
            SET    YearName  = LTRIM(RTRIM(@YearName)),
                   StartDate = @StartDate,
                   EndDate   = @EndD
ate,
                   IsCurrent = @IsCurrent,
                   Remarks   = NULLIF (LTRIM(RTRIM(@Remarks)), N''),
                   UpdatedAt = SYSDATETIME()
            WHERE  AcademicYearId = @AcademicYearId;
            IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
                THROW 56113, 'The selected academic year was not found.', 1;
            SELECT @AcademicYearId AS AcademicYearId;
        END
    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.GetStudentEnrollments
@UserId INT, @AdmissionId INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXECUTE dbo.RequirePermission @UserId, N'Fees.View';
    IF @AdmissionId <= 0
        THROW 52001, 'A valid student is required.', 1;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                   FROM   dbo.Students
                   WHERE  AdmissionId = @AdmissionId)
        THROW 52002, 'The selected student was not found.', 1;
    SELECT   E.EnrollmentId,
             E.AdmissionId,
             E.AcademicYearId,
             AY.YearName,
             E.ClassSectionId,
             C.ClassName,
             SEC.SectionName,
             E.EnrollmentDate,
             E.LeavingDate,
             E.Status,
             CAST (ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN BC.Status <> N'Cancelled' THEN dbo.GetFeeChargeBalance(BC.BillingChargeId) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DECIMAL (12, 2)) AS OutstandingAmount
    FROM     dbo.Enrollments AS E
             INNER JOIN
             dbo.AcademicYears AS AY
             ON AY.AcademicYearId = E.AcademicYearId
             INNER JOIN
             dbo.CampusClassSections AS CCS
             ON CCS.ClassSectionId = E.ClassSectionId
             INNER JOIN
             dbo.Classes AS C
             ON C.ClassId = CCS.ClassId
             INNER JOIN
             dbo.Sections AS SEC
         
    ON SEC.SectionId = CCS.SectionId
             LEFT OUTER JOIN
             dbo.BillingCharges AS BC
             ON BC.EnrollmentId = E.EnrollmentId
    WHERE    E.AdmissionId = @AdmissionId
    GROUP BY E.EnrollmentId, E.AdmissionId, E.AcademicYearId, AY.YearName, E.ClassSectionId, C.ClassName, SEC.SectionName, E.EnrollmentDate, E.LeavingDate, E.Status
    HAVING   E.Status = N'Active'
             OR ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN BC.Status <> N'Cancelled' THEN dbo.GetFeeChargeBalance(BC.BillingChargeId) ELSE 0 END), 0) > 0
             OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
                        FROM   dbo.StudentFeeAssignments AS SFA
                        WHERE  SFA.EnrollmentId = E.EnrollmentId
                               AND SFA.CancelledAt IS NULL)
    ORDER BY CASE WHEN E.Status = N'Active' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN E.Status = N'Active' THEN E.EnrollmentId END DESC, OutstandingAmount DESC, E.EnrollmentId DESC;
END

hes the permission already required by three of this page's

    SELECT

        E.ClassSectionId,
        CCS.CampusId, CMP.CampusName, C.ClassId, SEC.SectionId,

        E.EnrollmentDate,
        E.LeavingDate, E.BillingStartDate,
        E.Status

    FROM dbo.Enrollments E

    INNER JOIN dbo.AcademicYears AY

    INNER JOIN dbo.CampusClassSections CCS

    INNER JOIN dbo.Classes C
        ON C.ClassId = CCS.ClassId

    INNER JOIN dbo.Sections SEC

    WHERE E.AdmissionId = @AdmissionId

    ORDER BY
        CASE

            ELSE 1
        END,

        E.EnrollmentId DESC;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. dbo.GetStudentLifecycleTimeline
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--
-- One merged, chronological feed of everything that has ever happened to
-- a student's admission/enrollment/leave record, for the Console's history
-- panel. EnrollmentHistory and StudentStatusHistory already record almost
-- everything the app does to a student (transfers, promotions, re-admits,
-- status changes, and now corrections); LeaveCertificates rows are folded
-- in too since a created leave record is itself a lifecycle event.

CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.GetStudentLifecycleTimeline
    @UserId INT,
    @AdmissionId INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXEC dbo.RequirePermission
        @UserId,
        N'Students
.View';

    IF @AdmissionId <= 0
        THROW 57201, 'A valid student is required.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Students WHERE AdmissionId = @AdmissionId
    )
        THROW 57202, 'The selected student was not found.', 1;

    SELECT
        EventDate,
        EventType,
        Description,
        RecordedByUserId,
        CreatedAt
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            EH.ActionDate AS EventDate,
            N'Enrollment: ' + EH.ActionType AS EventType,
            ISNULL(OSC.ClassName + N' ' + OSEC.SectionName, N'—')
                + N' ? '
                + ISNULL(NSC.ClassName + N' ' + NSEC.SectionName, N'—')
                + CASE
                      WHEN EH.OldStatus IS NOT NULL
                           AND EH.NewStatus IS NOT NULL
                           AND EH.OldStatus <> EH.NewStatus
                          THEN N' (' + EH.OldStatus + N' ? ' + EH.NewStatus + N')'
                      WHEN EH.NewStatus IS NOT NULL
                          THEN N' (' + EH.NewStatus + N')'
                      ELSE N''
                  END
                + ISNULL(N' — ' + EH.Remarks, N'') AS Description,
            EH.UserId AS RecordedByUserId,
            EH.CreatedAt
        FROM dbo.EnrollmentHistory EH
        LEFT JOIN dbo.CampusClassSections OCCS ON OCCS.ClassSectionId = EH.OldClassSectionId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.Classes OSC ON OSC.ClassId = OCCS.ClassId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.Sections OSEC ON OSEC.SectionId = OCCS.SectionId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.CampusClassSections NCCS ON NCCS.ClassSectionId = EH.NewClassSectionId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.Classes NSC ON NSC.ClassId = NCCS.ClassId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.Sections NSEC ON NSEC.SectionId = NCCS.SectionId
        WHERE EH.AdmissionId = @AdmissionId

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            SH.EffectiveDate AS EventDate,
            N'Status change' AS Even
tType,
            SH.OldStatus + N' ? ' + SH.NewStatus
                + ISNULL(N' (' + SH.Reason + N')', N'')
                + ISNULL(N' — ' + SH.Remarks, N'') AS Description,
            SH.CreatedBy AS RecordedByUserId,
            SH.CreatedAt
        FROM dbo.StudentStatusHistory SH
        WHERE SH.AdmissionId = @AdmissionId

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            LC.LeaveDate AS EventDate,
            N'Leave certificate' AS EventType,
            N'Leave certificate created for class ' + ISNULL(LC.ClassStudied, N'—')
                + ISNULL(N' — ' + LC.Remarks, N'') AS Description,
            LC.CreatedByUserId AS RecordedByUserId,
            LC.CreatedAt
        FROM dbo.LeaveCertificates LC
        WHERE LC.AdmissionId = @AdmissionId
    ) AS Timeline
    ORDER BY EventDate DESC, CreatedAt DESC;
END;

    SELECT
        X.TransactionId,
        X.TransactionType,
        X.EnrollmentId,
        X.TransactionDate,
        X.FeeTypeName,
        X.ChargeType,
        X.BillingMonth,
        X.Amount,
        X.PaidAmount,
        X.DebitAmount,
        X.FeePaymentId,
        X.ReceiptNumber,
        X.PaymentMethod,
        X.Remarks
    FROM
    (
        /* =====================================================
           BILLING CHARGES
           ===================================================== */

        SELECT
            BC.BillingChargeId AS TransactionId,
            N'CHARGE' AS TransactionType,
            BC.EnrollmentId,
            BC.ChargeDate AS TransactionDate,
            FT.FeeTypeName,
            FT.FeeTypeName AS ChargeType,
            BC.BillingMonth,

            BC.NetAmount
 AS Amount,

            CAST(0.00 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
                AS PaidAmount,

            BC.NetAmount AS DebitAmount,

            CAST(NULL AS INT)
                AS FeePaymentId,

            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(40))
                AS ReceiptNumber,

            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(30))
                AS PaymentMethod,

            BC.Remarks

        FROM dbo.BillingCharges BC

        INNER JOIN dbo.FeeTypes FT
            ON FT.FeeTypeId = BC.FeeTypeId

        WHERE BC.AdmissionId = @AdmissionId
          AND (
                @FromDate IS NULL
                OR BC.ChargeDate >= @FromDate
              )
          AND (
                @ToDate IS NULL
                OR BC.ChargeDate <= @ToDate
              )
          AND BC.Status <> N'Cancelled'


        UNION ALL


        /* =====================================================
           PAYMENTS / REFUNDS / CORRECTIONS / REVERSALS
           ===================================================== */

        SELECT
            FP.FeePaymentId AS TransactionId,

            CASE
                WHEN FP.Status = N'Reversed'
                    THEN N'PAYMENT-REVERSED'

                WHEN FP.TotalAmount < 0
                     AND FP.PaymentMethod = N'Correction'
                    THEN N'CORRECTION'

                WHEN FP.TotalAmount < 0
                    THEN N'REFUND'

                ELSE N'PAYMENT'
            END AS TransactionType,

            FP.EnrollmentId,

            FP.PaymentDate AS TransactionDate,


            /* -------------------------------------------------
               Description
               ------------------------------------------------- */

            CASE
                WHEN FP.TotalAmount < 0
                     AND FP.PaymentMethod = N'Correction'
           
         THEN N'Fee Correction'

                WHEN FP.TotalAmount < 0
                    THEN N'Fee Refund'

                ELSE N'Payment'
            END AS FeeTypeName,


            /* -------------------------------------------------
               CHARGE TYPE
               
               A payment can cover multiple charges.
               Return all related fee types.
               ------------------------------------------------- */

            ISNULL(
                STUFF(
                    (
                        SELECT
                            N', ' + FT2.FeeTypeName

                        FROM dbo.FeePaymentAllocations FPA2

                        INNER JOIN dbo.BillingCharges BC2
                            ON BC2.BillingChargeId =
                               FPA2.BillingChargeId

                        INNER JOIN dbo.FeeTypes FT2
                            ON FT2.FeeTypeId =
                               BC2.FeeTypeId

                        WHERE FPA2.FeePaymentId =
                              FP.FeePaymentId

                        GROUP BY
                            FT2.FeeTypeName

                        ORDER BY
                            MIN(FPA2.FeePaymentAllocationId)

                        FOR XML PATH(N''),
                            TYPE
                    ).value(
                        N'.',
                        N'NVARCHAR(MAX)'
                    ),
                    1,
                    2,
                    N''
                ),
                N''
            ) AS ChargeType,


            NULL AS BillingMonth,


            /* -------------------------------------------------
               ACTUAL TRANSACTION AMOUNT
               
               Positive collection:
                   +1000

               Refund:
          
         -500

               Correction:
                   -500

               Reversed payment:
                   0
               ------------------------------------------------- */

            CASE
                WHEN FP.Status = N'Completed'
                    THEN FP.TotalAmount

                ELSE
                    CAST(0.00 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
            END AS Amount,


            /* -------------------------------------------------
               MONEY RECEIVED / RETURNED
               ------------------------------------------------- */

            CASE
                WHEN FP.Status = N'Completed'
                    THEN FP.TotalAmount

                ELSE
                    CAST(0.00 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
            END AS PaidAmount,


            /* -------------------------------------------------
               DEBIT / REDUCTION
               
               Refund and correction are negative transactions,
               so DebitAmount remains positive for statement
               calculations.
               ------------------------------------------------- */

            CASE
                WHEN FP.Status = N'Completed'
                     AND FP.TotalAmount < 0
                    THEN -FP.TotalAmount

                ELSE
                    CAST(0.00 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
            END AS DebitAmount,


            FP.FeePaymentId,
            FP.ReceiptNumber,
            FP.PaymentMethod,


            /* -------------------------------------------------
               REMARKS
               ------------------------------------------------- */

            CASE
                WHEN FP.RelatedFeePaymentId IS NOT NULL
                    THEN CONCAT(

                        COALESCE(
                            NULLIF(
                                FP.Remarks,

                                N''
                            ),
                            N''
                        ),

                        CASE
                            WHEN NULLIF(
                                    FP.Remarks,
                                    N''
                                 ) IS NOT NULL
                                THEN N' | '

                            ELSE N''
                        END,

                        CASE
                            WHEN FP.PaymentMethod =
                                 N'Correction'
                                THEN N'Correction of receipt '

                            ELSE N'Refund of receipt '
                        END,

                        COALESCE(
                            (
                                SELECT
                                    ReceiptNumber

                                FROM dbo.FeePayments OP

                                WHERE OP.FeePaymentId =
                                      FP.RelatedFeePaymentId
                            ),
                            N''
                        )
                    )

                WHEN FP.Status = N'Reversed'
                    THEN CONCAT(

                        COALESCE(
                            NULLIF(
                                FP.Remarks,
                                N''
                            ),
                            N''
                        ),

                        CASE
                            WHEN NULLIF(
                                    FP.Remarks,
                                    N''
                                 ) IS NOT NULL
                                THEN N' | '

                            ELSE N''
                        END,

                        N'Status: Reversed'
            
        )

                ELSE
                    FP.Remarks
            END AS Remarks

        FROM dbo.FeePayments FP

        WHERE FP.AdmissionId = @AdmissionId

          AND FP.Status IN
          (
              N'Completed',
              N'Reversed'
          )

          AND (
                @FromDate IS NULL
                OR FP.PaymentDate >= @FromDate
              )

          AND (
                @ToDate IS NULL
                OR FP.PaymentDate <= @ToDate
              )
    ) X

    /* =========================================================
       NEWEST TRANSACTIONS FIRST
       ========================================================= */

    ORDER BY
        X.TransactionDate DESC,

        X.TransactionId DESC;

END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.RequireAnyPermission
@UserId INT, @PermissionCode1 NVARCHAR (100), @PermissionCode2 NVARCHAR (100)=NULL, @PermissionCode3 NVARCHAR (100)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                   FROM   dbo.Users
                   WHERE  UserId = @UserId)
        BEGIN
            THROW 50003, 'The specified user is not authenticated.', 1;
        END
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1
               FROM   dbo.Users AS U
                      INNER JOIN
                      dbo.Roles AS R
                      ON R.RoleId = U.RoleId
               WHERE  U.UserId = @UserId
                      AND R.RoleName = N'Administrator')
        BEGIN
            RETURN;
       
 END
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1
               FROM   dbo.UserRoles AS UR
                      INNER JOIN
                      dbo.Roles AS R
                      ON R.RoleId = UR.RoleId
                      INNER JOIN
                      dbo.RolePermissions AS RP
                      ON RP.RoleId = R.RoleId
                      INNER JOIN
                      dbo.Permissions AS P
                      ON P.PermissionId = RP.PermissionId
               WHERE  UR.UserId = @UserId
                      AND (P.PermissionCode = @PermissionCode1
                           OR (@PermissionCode2 IS NOT NULL
                               AND P.PermissionCode = @PermissionCode2)
                           OR (@PermissionCode3 IS NOT NULL
                               AND P.PermissionCode = @PermissionCode3)))
        BEGIN
            RETURN;
        END;
    THROW 50003, 'You are not authorized to perform this operation.', 1;
END

-- SyncTransferStudentFees_Internal
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.SyncTransferStudentFees_Internal
@UserId INT, @EnrollmentId INT, @FeePolicy NVARCHAR (20), @Reason NVARCHAR (500), @EffectiveDate DATE=NULL, @FeeEffectiveMonth DATE=NULL, @ReplaceScheduledFees BIT=0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF @FeePolicy NOT IN (N'NEXT_MONTH', N'CURRENT_MONTH', N'CUSTOM_MONTH')
        THROW 59300, 'Invalid fee synchronization policy.', 1;
    IF @Reason IS NULL
       OR LTRIM(RTRIM(@Reason)) = N''
        THROW 59301, 'A reason is required to synchronize fees after a transfer.', 1;
    DECLARE @Admissi
onId AS INT, @CampusId AS INT, @ClassId AS INT;
    SELECT @AdmissionId = E.AdmissionId,
           @CampusId = CCS.CampusId,
           @ClassId = CCS.ClassId
    FROM   dbo.Enrollments AS E
           INNER JOIN
           dbo.CampusClassSections AS CCS
           ON CCS.ClassSectionId = E.ClassSectionId
    WHERE  E.EnrollmentId = @EnrollmentId
           AND E.Status = N'Active';
    IF @AdmissionId IS NULL
        THROW 59302, 'The selected enrollment does not exist or is not active.', 1;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                   FROM   dbo.FeeConfigurations WITH (HOLDLOCK)
                   WHERE  CampusId = @CampusId
                          AND ClassId = @ClassId)
        THROW 59306, 'No destination fees are configured. Keep existing fees or complete Fee Setup first.', 1;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1
               FROM   dbo.StudentFeeAssignments AS SFA
                      INNER JOIN
                      dbo.FeeTypes AS FT
                      ON FT.FeeTypeId = SFA.FeeTypeId
               WHERE  SFA.EnrollmentId = @EnrollmentId
                      AND SFA.EffectiveTo IS NULL
                      AND SFA.CancelledAt IS NULL
                      AND FT.IsMandatory = 1
                      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                      FROM   dbo.FeeConfigurations AS FC WITH (HOLDLOCK)
                                      WHERE  FC.CampusId = @CampusId
                                             AND FC.ClassId = @ClassId
                                             AND FC.FeeTypeId = SFA.FeeTypeId))
        THROW 59307, 'Required destination fees are missing. Keep existing fees or complete Fee Setup first.', 1;
    DECLARE @Today AS DATE = COALESCE(@EffectiveDate,CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE));
    DECLARE @CurrentMonthStart AS DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today), MONTH(@Today), 1);
    DECLARE @TargetMonth AS DATE = CASE @FeePolicy WHEN N'CURRENT_MONTH' THEN @CurrentMo
nthStart WHEN N'CUSTOM_MONTH' THEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@FeeEffectiveMonth),MONTH(@FeeEffectiveMonth),1) ELSE DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @CurrentMonthStart) END;

    IF @TargetMonth IS NULL OR @TargetMonth<@CurrentMonthStart
        THROW 59327,'Choose an effective month on or after the transfer month.',1;
    DECLARE @InitialLockedRows int;
    SELECT @InitialLockedRows=COUNT(*) FROM dbo.StudentFeeAssignments WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE EnrollmentId=@EnrollmentId;
    SELECT @InitialLockedRows=COUNT(*) FROM dbo.BillingCharges WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE EnrollmentId=@EnrollmentId;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#FeeSyncPlan') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE #FeeSyncPlan;
    CREATE TABLE #FeeSyncPlan (
        FeeTypeId             INT             NOT NULL,
        CurrentAssignmentId   INT             NULL,
        CurrentDiscountAmount DECIMAL (12, 2) NULL,
        CurrentRemarks        NVARCHAR (500)  NULL,
        DestAmount            DECIMAL (12, 2) NULL,
        DestFrequency         NVARCHAR (20)   NULL,
        PlanAction            NVARCHAR (20)   NOT NULL
    );
    WITH CurrentOpen
    AS   (SELECT StudentFeeAssignmentId,
                 FeeTypeId,
                 Amount,
                 Frequency,
                 DiscountAmount,
                 Remarks
          FROM   dbo.StudentFeeAssignments
          WHERE  EnrollmentId = @EnrollmentId
                 AND EffectiveTo IS NULL
                 AND CancelledAt IS NULL),
         DestConfig
    AS   (SELECT FC.FeeConfigurationId,
                 FC.FeeTypeId,
                 FC.Amount,
                 FC.Frequency
          FROM   dbo.FeeConfigurations AS FC
                 INNER JOIN
                 dbo.FeeTypes AS FT
                 ON FT.FeeTypeId = FC.FeeTypeId
          WHERE  FC.CampusId = @CampusId
                 AND FC.ClassId = @ClassId
                 AND FC.Frequency IN (N'Monthly', N'Yearly')
                 -- 
A transfer must not undo an explicit cancellation.
                 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.StudentFeeAssignments CX
                                 WHERE CX.EnrollmentId=@EnrollmentId AND CX.FeeTypeId=FC.FeeTypeId
                                   AND CX.EffectiveTo IS NULL AND CX.CancelledAt IS NOT NULL)
                 AND (FT.IsMandatory = 1
                      OR (FT.IsTransportLinked = 1
                          AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                      FROM   CurrentOpen AS CO
                                      WHERE  CO.FeeTypeId = FC.FeeTypeId))))
    INSERT #FeeSyncPlan (FeeTypeId, CurrentAssignmentId, CurrentDiscountAmount, CurrentRemarks, DestAmount, DestFrequency, PlanAction)
    SELECT COALESCE (CO.FeeTypeId, DC.FeeTypeId),
           CO.StudentFeeAssignmentId,
           CO.DiscountAmount,
           CO.Remarks,
           DC.Amount,
           DC.Frequency,
           CASE WHEN CO.StudentFeeAssignmentId IS NOT NULL
                     AND DC.FeeConfigurationId IS NOT NULL
                     AND (CO.Amount <> DC.Amount
                          OR CO.Frequency <> DC.Frequency
                          OR (@ReplaceScheduledFees=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.StudentFeeAssignments S
                              WHERE S.EnrollmentId=@EnrollmentId AND S.FeeTypeId=CO.FeeTypeId AND S.CancelledAt IS NULL
                              AND S.StudentFeeAssignmentId<>CO.StudentFeeAssignmentId AND ISNULL(S.EffectiveTo,'99991231')>=@TargetMonth))) THEN N'CHANGE' WHEN CO.StudentFeeAssignmentId IS NULL
                                                                               AND DC.FeeConfigurationId IS NOT NULL THEN N'ADD' WHEN CO.StudentFeeAssignmentId IS NOT NULL
                                                                                                                                      AND DC.FeeConfigurationId IS NULL THEN N'DISCONTINUE' ELSE N'NONE' END
    FROM   CurrentO
pen AS CO
           FULL OUTER JOIN
           DestConfig AS DC
           ON DC.FeeTypeId = CO.FeeTypeId;

    -- TRANSFER_TIMELINE_GUARD: validate all versions and bills under the caller transaction.
    IF @@TRANCOUNT=0 THROW 59321,'Transfer fee changes require a transaction.',1;
    DECLARE @LockedRows int;
    SELECT @LockedRows=COUNT(*) FROM dbo.StudentFeeAssignments WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE EnrollmentId=@EnrollmentId;
    SELECT @LockedRows=COUNT(*) FROM dbo.BillingCharges WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE EnrollmentId=@EnrollmentId;
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.StudentFeeAssignments
        WHERE EnrollmentId=@EnrollmentId AND CancelledAt IS NULL
          AND EffectiveFrom>EffectiveTo)
        THROW 59322,'An existing fee period ends before it starts. Review Fee Changes before applying transfer fees. You can keep current fees.',1;
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.StudentFeeAssignments A JOIN dbo.StudentFeeAssignments B
        ON A.EnrollmentId=B.EnrollmentId AND A.FeeTypeId=B.FeeTypeId
        AND A.StudentFeeAssignmentId<B.StudentFeeAssignmentId
        WHERE A.EnrollmentId=@EnrollmentId AND A.CancelledAt IS NULL AND B.CancelledAt IS NULL
        AND ISNULL(A.EffectiveFrom,'19000101')<=ISNULL(B.EffectiveTo,'99991231')
        AND ISNULL(B.EffectiveFrom,'19000101')<=ISNULL(A.EffectiveTo,'99991231'))
        THROW 59323,'Existing fee periods overlap. Review Fee Changes before applying transfer fees. You can keep current fees.',1;
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #FeeSyncPlan P JOIN dbo.BillingCharges BC
        ON BC.EnrollmentId=@EnrollmentId AND BC.FeeTypeId=P.FeeTypeId
        WHERE P.PlanAction<>N'NONE' AND BC.BillingMonth>=@TargetMonth)
        THROW 59324,'A changed fee is already billed for this month or later. Keep current fees and choose a later effective month in Fee Changes.',1;
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #FeeSyncPlan P JOIN dbo.StudentFeeAssignments A
        ON A.EnrollmentId=@EnrollmentId AND A.FeeTypeId=P.FeeTypeId
        W
HERE @ReplaceScheduledFees=0 AND P.PlanAction<>N'NONE' AND A.CancelledAt IS NULL
        AND ((A.StudentFeeAssignmentId=P.CurrentAssignmentId AND A.EffectiveFrom>=@TargetMonth)
          OR (A.StudentFeeAssignmentId<>ISNULL(P.CurrentAssignmentId,-1)
            AND ISNULL(A.EffectiveTo,'99991231')>=@TargetMonth)))
        THROW 59325,'A changed fee has a scheduled rate or waiver. Keep current fees, then explicitly review that schedule in Fee Changes.',1;
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #FeeSyncPlan WHERE PlanAction=N'CHANGE'
        AND CurrentDiscountAmount>DestAmount)
        THROW 59326,'The existing discount exceeds the new fee. Keep current fees and review the discount explicitly.',1;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                   FROM   #FeeSyncPlan
                   WHERE  PlanAction <> N'NONE')
        RETURN;
    DECLARE @PlanFeeTypeId AS INT, @PlanAssignmentId AS INT, @PlanDiscount AS DECIMAL (12, 2), @PlanRemarks AS NVARCHAR (500), @PlanDestAmount AS DECIMAL (12, 2), @PlanDestFrequency AS NVARCHAR (20), @PlanAction AS NVARCHAR (20), @PlanFeeTypeName AS NVARCHAR (100);
    DECLARE @LastBilledMonth AS DATE, @OperationId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @NewAssignmentId AS INT, @OldValues AS NVARCHAR (MAX), @NewValues AS NVARCHAR (MAX), @DiscontinueEffectiveTo AS DATE;
    DECLARE plan_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD
        FOR SELECT P.FeeTypeId,
                   P.CurrentAssignmentId,
                   P.CurrentDiscountAmount,
                   P.CurrentRemarks,
                   P.DestAmount,
                   P.DestFrequency,
                   P.PlanAction,
                   FT.FeeTypeName
            FROM   #FeeSyncPlan AS P
                   INNER JOIN
                   dbo.FeeTypes AS FT
                   ON FT.FeeTypeId = P.FeeTypeId
            WHERE  P.PlanAction <> N'NONE';
    OPEN plan_cursor;
    FETCH NEXT FROM plan_cursor INTO @PlanFeeTypeId, @PlanAssignmentId, @PlanDiscount, @PlanRemarks, @PlanDestAmount, 
@PlanDestFrequency, @PlanAction, @PlanFeeTypeName;
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN

                    IF @ReplaceScheduledFees=1 AND @PlanAction IN(N'CHANGE',N'ADD',N'DISCONTINUE')
                    BEGIN
                        DECLARE @Replaced TABLE(StudentFeeAssignmentId int,OldFrom date,OldTo date,NewTo date,CancelledAt datetime2);
                        UPDATE A SET EffectiveTo=CASE WHEN A.EffectiveFrom IS NULL OR A.EffectiveFrom<@TargetMonth
                                THEN DATEADD(MONTH,-1,@TargetMonth) ELSE COALESCE(A.EffectiveTo,A.EffectiveFrom) END,
                            CancelledAt=CASE WHEN A.EffectiveFrom>=@TargetMonth THEN SYSDATETIME() ELSE A.CancelledAt END,
                            UpdatedAt=SYSDATETIME()
                        OUTPUT inserted.StudentFeeAssignmentId,deleted.EffectiveFrom,deleted.EffectiveTo,inserted.EffectiveTo,inserted.CancelledAt INTO @Replaced
                        FROM dbo.StudentFeeAssignments A
                        WHERE A.EnrollmentId=@EnrollmentId AND A.FeeTypeId=@PlanFeeTypeId AND A.CancelledAt IS NULL
                            AND ISNULL(A.EffectiveTo,'99991231')>=@TargetMonth;
                        DECLARE @ScheduleOperation uniqueidentifier=NEWID(),@ScheduleValues nvarchar(max);
                        SET @ScheduleValues=(SELECT @EnrollmentId EnrollmentId,@PlanFeeTypeId FeeTypeId,
                            @TargetMonth EffectiveFrom,@Reason Reason,JSON_QUERY((SELECT * FROM @Replaced FOR JSON PATH)) ReplacedPeriods
                            FOR JSON PATH,WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER);
                        INSERT dbo.AuditOperations(OperationId,UserId,OperationType,CorrelationNote)
                        VALUES(@ScheduleOperation,@UserId,N'FEE_SYNC_TRANSFER_SCHEDULE',CONVERT(nvarchar(200),@EnrollmentId));
                        EXEC dbo.WriteAuditLog @OperationId=@ScheduleOperation,@UserId=@UserId,@TableName=N'StudentFeeAssignments',
                            @RecordId=@PlanAssignmen
tId,@Action=N'UPDATE',@OldValues=NULL,@NewValues=@ScheduleValues;
                        DELETE FROM @Replaced;
                    END;
            IF @PlanAction = N'CHANGE'
                BEGIN
                    SELECT @LastBilledMonth = MAX(BillingMonth)
                    FROM   dbo.BillingCharges
                    WHERE  StudentFeeAssignmentId = @PlanAssignmentId;
                    IF @LastBilledMonth IS NOT NULL
                       AND @TargetMonth <= @LastBilledMonth
                        BEGIN
                            CLOSE plan_cursor;
                            DEALLOCATE plan_cursor;
                            THROW 59304, 'The destination fees could not be applied from the selected month because that month has already been billed for one or more fees. Choose "next month" instead, or keep the existing fees, then adjust manually in Fee Setup if needed.', 1;
                        END
                    UPDATE dbo.StudentFeeAssignments
                    SET    EffectiveTo = DATEADD(MONTH, -1, @TargetMonth),
                           UpdatedAt   = SYSDATETIME()
                    WHERE  StudentFeeAssignmentId = @PlanAssignmentId
                           AND EffectiveTo IS NULL AND CancelledAt IS NULL
                           AND (EffectiveFrom IS NULL OR EffectiveFrom<@TargetMonth);
                    INSERT  dbo.StudentFeeAssignments (EnrollmentId, AdmissionId, FeeTypeId, Amount, DiscountAmount, Frequency, Remarks, EffectiveFrom, EffectiveTo)
                    VALUES                           (@EnrollmentId, @AdmissionId, @PlanFeeTypeId, @PlanDestAmount, @PlanDiscount, @PlanDestFrequency, @PlanRemarks, @TargetMonth, NULL);
                    SET @NewAssignmentId = CONVERT (INT, SCOPE_IDENTITY());
                    SET @OperationId = NEWID();
                    INSERT  dbo.AuditOperations (OperationId, UserId, OperationType, CorrelationNote)
                    VALUES                
     (@OperationId, @UserId, N'FEE_SYNC_TRANSFER', CONVERT (NVARCHAR (200), @PlanAssignmentId) + N' -> ' + CONVERT (NVARCHAR (200), @NewAssignmentId));
                    SET @OldValues = (SELECT @PlanAssignmentId AS StudentFeeAssignmentId,
                                             @PlanFeeTypeName AS FeeTypeName
                                      FOR    JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER, INCLUDE_NULL_VALUES);
                    SET @NewValues = (SELECT @NewAssignmentId AS StudentFeeAssignmentId,
                                             @PlanFeeTypeName AS FeeTypeName,
                                             @PlanDestAmount AS Amount,
                                             @TargetMonth AS EffectiveFrom,
                                             @Reason AS Reason,
                                             @EnrollmentId AS EnrollmentId,
                                             @PlanAssignmentId AS PreviousVersionId
                                      FOR    JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER, INCLUDE_NULL_VALUES);
                    EXECUTE dbo.WriteAuditLog @OperationId = @OperationId, @UserId = @UserId, @TableName = N'StudentFeeAssignments', @RecordId = @PlanAssignmentId, @Action = N'UPDATE', @OldValues = @OldValues, @NewValues = @NewValues;
                END
            ELSE
                IF @PlanAction = N'ADD'
                    BEGIN
                        INSERT  dbo.StudentFeeAssignments (EnrollmentId, AdmissionId, FeeTypeId, Amount, DiscountAmount, Frequency, Remarks, EffectiveFrom, EffectiveTo)
                        VALUES                           (@EnrollmentId, @AdmissionId, @PlanFeeTypeId, @PlanDestAmount, 0, @PlanDestFrequency, N'Added via transfer fee sync', @TargetMonth, NULL);
                        SET @NewAssignmentId = CONVERT (INT, SCOPE_IDENTITY());
                        SET @OperationId = NEWID();
                        INSERT  dbo.AuditOperations (OperationId, UserId, O
perationType, CorrelationNote)
                        VALUES                     (@OperationId, @UserId, N'FEE_SYNC_TRANSFER', CONVERT (NVARCHAR (200), @NewAssignmentId));
                        SET @NewValues = (SELECT @NewAssignmentId AS StudentFeeAssignmentId,
                                                 @PlanFeeTypeName AS FeeTypeName,
                                                 @PlanDestAmount AS Amount,
                                                 @TargetMonth AS EffectiveFrom,
                                                 @Reason AS Reason,
                                                 @EnrollmentId AS EnrollmentId
                                          FOR    JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER, INCLUDE_NULL_VALUES);
                        EXECUTE dbo.WriteAuditLog @OperationId = @OperationId, @UserId = @UserId, @TableName = N'StudentFeeAssignments', @RecordId = @NewAssignmentId, @Action = N'INSERT', @OldValues = NULL, @NewValues = @NewValues;
                    END
                ELSE
                    IF @PlanAction = N'DISCONTINUE'
                        BEGIN
                            SET @DiscontinueEffectiveTo = DATEADD(MONTH, -1, @TargetMonth);
                            SELECT @LastBilledMonth = MAX(BillingMonth)
                            FROM   dbo.BillingCharges
                            WHERE  StudentFeeAssignmentId = @PlanAssignmentId;
                            IF @LastBilledMonth IS NOT NULL
                               AND @DiscontinueEffectiveTo < @LastBilledMonth
                                BEGIN
                                    CLOSE plan_cursor;
                                    DEALLOCATE plan_cursor;
                                    THROW 59305, 'One or more fees that no longer apply at the destination could not be closed because a later month has already been billed for them. Please review those fees manually in Fee Setup.', 1;
                      
          END
                            UPDATE dbo.StudentFeeAssignments
                            SET    EffectiveTo = @DiscontinueEffectiveTo,
                                   UpdatedAt   = SYSDATETIME()
                            WHERE  StudentFeeAssignmentId = @PlanAssignmentId
                                   AND EffectiveTo IS NULL AND CancelledAt IS NULL
                           AND (EffectiveFrom IS NULL OR EffectiveFrom<@TargetMonth);
                            SET @OperationId = NEWID();
                            INSERT  dbo.AuditOperations (OperationId, UserId, OperationType, CorrelationNote)
                            VALUES                     (@OperationId, @UserId, N'FEE_SYNC_TRANSFER', CONVERT (NVARCHAR (200), @PlanAssignmentId));
                            SET @NewValues = (SELECT @PlanAssignmentId AS StudentFeeAssignmentId,
                                                     @PlanFeeTypeName AS FeeTypeName,
                                                     @DiscontinueEffectiveTo AS EffectiveTo,
                                                     @Reason AS Reason,
                                                     @EnrollmentId AS EnrollmentId
                                              FOR    JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER, INCLUDE_NULL_VALUES);
                            EXECUTE dbo.WriteAuditLog @OperationId = @OperationId, @UserId = @UserId, @TableName = N'StudentFeeAssignments', @RecordId = @PlanAssignmentId, @Action = N'UPDATE', @OldValues = NULL, @NewValues = @NewValues;
                        END
            FETCH NEXT FROM plan_cursor INTO @PlanFeeTypeId, @PlanAssignmentId, @PlanDiscount, @PlanRemarks, @PlanDestAmount, @PlanDestFrequency, @PlanAction, @PlanFeeTypeName;
        END
    CLOSE plan_cursor;
    DEALLOCATE plan_cursor;
DELETE dbo.AuditOperations WHERE OperationId=@OperationId AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.AuditLogs WHERE OperationId=@OperationId);
END

-- GetStudentFeeAssignments
CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.GetStudentFeeAssignments
@UserId INT, @EnrollmentId INT, @IncludeAvailableFees BIT=0, @IncludeCancelled BIT=0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXECUTE dbo.RequirePermission @UserId, N'Fees.View';
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                   FROM   dbo.Enrollments
                   WHERE  EnrollmentId = @EnrollmentId)
        THROW 53100, 'The selected enrollment does not exist.', 1;
    SELECT   SFA.StudentFeeAssignmentId,
             SFA.EnrollmentId,
           
  SFA.AdmissionId,
             SFA.FeeTypeId,
             FT.FeeTypeCode,
             FT.FeeTypeName,
             SFA.Amount AS StandardAmount,
             SFA.DiscountAmount,
             SFA.Amount - SFA.DiscountAmount AS NetAmount,
             SFA.Frequency,
             SFA.Remarks,
             SFA.EffectiveFrom,
             SFA.EffectiveTo,
             SFA.CancelledAt,
             FT.IsMandatory,
             FT.IsTransportLinked,
             CAST (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                     FROM   dbo.BillingCharges AS BC
                                     WHERE  BC.StudentFeeAssignmentId = SFA.StudentFeeAssignmentId) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS HasPayments,
             (SELECT MAX(BC.BillingMonth)
              FROM   dbo.BillingCharges AS BC
              WHERE  BC.StudentFeeAssignmentId = SFA.StudentFeeAssignmentId) AS LastBilledMonth
    FROM     dbo.StudentFeeAssignments AS SFA
             INNER JOIN
             dbo.FeeTypes AS FT
             ON FT.FeeTypeId = SFA.FeeTypeId
    WHERE    SFA.EnrollmentId = @EnrollmentId
             AND (@IncludeCancelled=1 OR SFA.CancelledAt IS NULL)
    ORDER BY FT.DisplayOrder, FT.FeeTypeName, SFA.EffectiveFrom;
    IF @IncludeAvailableFees = 1
        BEGIN
            SELECT   FC.FeeConfigurationId,
                     FC.CampusId,
                     FC.ClassId,
                     FC.FeeTypeId,
                     FT.FeeTypeCode,
                     FT.FeeTypeName,
                     FC.Amount,
                     FC.Frequency,
                     FC.Remarks,
                     FT.IsMandatory,
                     FT.IsTransportLinked
            FROM     dbo.Enrollments AS E
                     INNER JOIN
                     dbo.CampusClassSections AS CCS
                     ON CCS.ClassSectionId = E.ClassSectionId
                     INNER JOIN
                 
    dbo.FeeConfigurations AS FC
                     ON FC.CampusId = CCS.CampusId
                        AND FC.ClassId = CCS.ClassId
                     INNER JOIN
                     dbo.FeeTypes AS FT
                     ON FT.FeeTypeId = FC.FeeTypeId
            WHERE    E.EnrollmentId = @EnrollmentId
            ORDER BY FT.DisplayOrder, FT.FeeTypeName;
        END
END

-- Canonical single-student details, status and current placement read.

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.GetStudentDetails
(
    @UserId int,
    @AdmissionId int
)
AS

BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXEC dbo.RequirePermission
        @UserId,
        N'Students.View';

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Students
        WHERE AdmissionId = @AdmissionId
    )
        THROW 51700, 'The selected student was not found.', 1;

    SELECT
        S.AdmissionId,
        S.AdmissionNumber,
        S.RegistrationNumber,
        S.BiseEnrolmentNumber,
        S.CasteTribe,
        S.StudentName,
        S.FatherName,
        S.DateOfBirth,
        S.Gender,
        S.BFormNumber,
        S.Religion,
        S.BloodGroup,
        S.ContactNumber,
        S.AlternateContactNumber,
        S.Address,
        S.PreviousSchool,
        S.PlaceOfBirth,
        S.FatherOccupation,
        S.Disability,
        S.Status,
        S.WithdrawalDate,
        S.AdmissionDate,

        S.AdmissionCampusId,
        AC.CampusName AS AdmissionCampusName,

        E.EnrollmentId,
        E.EnrollmentDate,
        E.AcademicYearId,
        AY.YearName,
        E.ClassSectionId,
        E.UsesTransport,
        E.Status AS EnrollmentStatus,

        CCS.CampusId AS CurrentCampusId,
        CC.CampusName AS CurrentCampusName,

        C.ClassId,
        C.ClassCode,
        C.ClassName,

        SEC.SectionId,
        SEC.SectionName

    FROM dbo.Students AS S

    INNER JOIN dbo.Campuses AS AC
        ON AC.CampusId = S.AdmissionCampusId

    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1) *
        FROM dbo.Enrollments AS EE
        WHERE EE.AdmissionId = S.AdmissionId
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN EE.Status = N'Active' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            EE.EnrollmentDate DESC,

            EE.EnrollmentId DESC
    ) AS E

    LEFT JOIN dbo.AcademicYears AS AY
        ON AY.AcademicYearId = E.AcademicYearId


    LEFT JOIN dbo.CampusClassSections AS CCS
        ON CCS.ClassSectionId = E.ClassSectionId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.Campuses AS CC
        ON CC.CampusId = CCS.CampusId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.Classes AS C
        ON C.ClassId = CCS.ClassId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.Sections AS SEC
        ON SEC.SectionId = CCS.SectionId

    WHERE S.AdmissionId = @AdmissionId;
END;

/* =======================================================================
   C5 -- Student Strength Report: year-over-year / term-over-term trend
   (current strength vs. a chosen compare year) instead of a single
   snapshot. This is the procedure the Student Strength Report page calls.
   ======================================================================= */

CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.GetStudentStrengthTrendReport
    @UserId                 INT,
    @CampusId               INT = 0,
    @ClassId                INT = 0,
    @SectionId              INT = 0,
    @CurrentAcademicYearId  INT,
    @CompareAcademicYearId  INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXEC dbo.RequirePermission @UserId, N'Reports.View';

    ;WITH Counts AS
    (
        SELECT
            CCS.CampusId, CAMP.CampusName,
            CCS.ClassId, C.ClassName,
            CCS.SectionId, SEC.SectionName,
            E.AcademicYearId,
            COUNT(*) AS StudentCount
        FROM dbo.Enrollments E
        INNER JOIN dbo.CampusClassSections CCS ON CCS.ClassSectionId = E.ClassSectionId
        INNER JOIN dbo.Campuses CAMP ON CAMP.CampusId = CCS.CampusId
        INNER JOIN dbo.Classes C ON C.ClassId = CCS.ClassId
        INNER JOIN dbo.Sections SEC ON SEC.SectionId = CCS.SectionId
        WHERE E.Statu
s = N'Active'
          AND E.AcademicYearId IN (@CurrentAcademicYearId, @CompareAcademicYearId)
          AND (@CampusId = 0 OR CCS.CampusId = @CampusId)
          AND (@ClassId = 0 OR CCS.ClassId = @ClassId)
          AND (@SectionId = 0 OR CCS.SectionId = @SectionId)
        GROUP BY CCS.CampusId, CAMP.CampusName, CCS.ClassId, C.ClassName, CCS.SectionId, SEC.SectionName, E.AcademicYearId
    )
    SELECT
        ISNULL(Cur.CampusId, Cmp.CampusId) AS CampusId,
        ISNULL(Cur.CampusName, Cmp.CampusName) AS CampusName,
        ISNULL(Cur.ClassId, Cmp.ClassId) AS ClassId,
        ISNULL(Cur.ClassName, Cmp.ClassName) AS ClassName,
        ISNULL(Cur.SectionId, Cmp.SectionId) AS SectionId,
        ISNULL(Cur.SectionName, Cmp.SectionName) AS SectionName,
        ISNULL(Cur.StudentCount, 0) AS CurrentStrength,
        CASE WHEN @CompareAcademicYearId = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ISNULL(Cmp.StudentCount, 0) END AS CompareStrength,
        CASE WHEN @CompareAcademicYearId = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ISNULL(Cur.StudentCount, 0) - ISNULL(Cmp.StudentCount, 0) END AS Delta
    FROM (SELECT * FROM Counts WHERE AcademicYearId = @CurrentAcademicYearId) Cur
    FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM Counts WHERE AcademicYearId = @CompareAcademicYearId) Cmp
        ON Cur.CampusId = Cmp.CampusId AND Cur.ClassId = Cmp.ClassId AND Cur.SectionId = Cmp.SectionId
    ORDER BY CampusName, ClassName, SectionName;
END;
